Pour in coconut milk. Bring to boil and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir occasionally to avoid the coconut milk to get burned.
Put in green beans. Cook for 3 to 5 minutes while stirring gradually.
Serve with steamed rice. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Pork Dinuguan Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs Pork belly ( cut into 1/2-inch cubes)
instructions: In a pot, heat cooking oil then sauté garlic until golden brown.
Add sliced pork belly and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Add vinegar, then cover the pot and don't stir. Simmer for 20-30 minutes or until meat is tender.
Add green long chilies and simmer for about 1-2 minutes.
Stir while pouring the pork blood into the pot, continue stirring to distribute it equally until it boils.
Let it simmer for about 5 minutes or until sauce becomes thick.
TIP:  In a pan, fry remaining garlic cloves and once cooked, put it on top of Dinuguan for a more enticing smell.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Superb Tortang Dilis Recipe
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine vinegar, onion, garlic, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp ground black pepper.
In a mixing bowl, combine anchovies, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, flour, scrambled egg and water. Mix well and set aside.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Once hot, pour the anchovies mixture in a circular form. Then fry it for 5 minutes per side or until crispy brown.
Transfer into a plate and eat with dipping sauce. Enjoy!

title: Best Cheesy Broccoli Soup Recipe
instructions: Heat a casserole and put-in the butter. Let the butter melt.
Add-in the garlic and cook until it becomes soft and brown.
Then add the broccoli and chicken broth and milk.
Put-in garlic powder, ground black pepper and cheese. Let them boil for 5 minutes.
Pour-in the melted cornstarch and stir well. Let it simmer for another 5 minutes.
Transfer into a serving bowl. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Chewy Coconut Macaroons Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F.
Beat the egg in a mixing bowl. Add butter, vanilla extract, and sweetened milk. Whisk until well blended.
Add the desiccated coconut and salt. Fold until the mixture is distributed.
Arrange mini baking cups on a mini muffin pan. Scoop around 1 tablespoon of mixture and place it into each baking cup.
Put the muffin pan in the oven. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven. Let it cool down.
Transfer to a plate. Serve for dessert. Enjoy!

title: Best Pininyahang Manok Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup Fresh milk or evaporated milk
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté garlic and onion.
Then, add the chicken. Put the black pepper and fish sauce. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the pineapple juice and pineapple chunks. Cover and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until the chicken is tender or half of the liquid evaporated.
Pour the fresh milk and cornstarch. Stir and cook for another minute.
Serve while hot and enjoy!

title: Superb Humbang Pata ng Baboy Cooking Instruction
instructions: In a casserole, combine pig's leg with other dry ingredients like oregano, banana blossom, bay leaf, whole cloves, onion and garlic.
Then pour-in water, vinegar, and soy sauce. Cover the casserole and cook for about 1 hour.Note: Lower the heat when boiling.
Wait until the pata is tender. Then add sugar and cook again for another 30 minutes over low heat.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Superb Lomi Recipe
instructions: Wash the lomi noodles with water and drain. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pot. Sauté garlic until brown, then add the onions.
Then add the pork and gizzard. Cook for about 3-5 minutes.
Put the black pepper and fish sauce, add 2 cups of water then cook while covered for 10 minutes. Lower the heat when boiling.
Add the pig's liver and cook for 5 minutes.
Then put the squid balls, kikiam and carrot. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Pour-in the remaining water, then the lomi noodles and melted cornstarch.
Add the scrambled eggs and stir well. Then put-in the cabbage and cook for another 3-5 minutes.
Transfer into a serving plate. Enjoy eating!

title: Superb Homemade Potato Chips Recipe
instructions: Slice the potatoes as thinly as possible then place in an open container.
Pour the water in the container with sliced potatoes (you may add additional water as needed). Soak the potatoes for 30 minutes.
Then, remove the potatoes from the container and transfer in a plate with paper tissue. Let it dry.
After drying, put the potatoes in a bowl then season with pepper, garlic powder and celery powder. Mix well. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pot. Deep fry the potatoes until the color turn golden brown and the texture become crispy.
Remove from the pan and transfer into a serving plate.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Seafood Paella Recipe
instructions: Heat a cooking pan and pour olive oil.
Once the oil is hot, cook the shrimp then remove from the pan. Set aside.
In the same pan, half cook the squid then remove from the pan. Set aside.
Put-in garlic, onion and tomatoes in the same pan then saute until tomatoes melt.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika and saffron.
Pour-in the shrimp stock and water then stir well. Bring to a boil.
Then add the rice and glutinous rice. Cover and cook for about 20 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, flatten it over the pan and sprinkle green peas on top.
Arrange the squid, shrimp, mussels, clams and crabs on top of the rice, and cook for another 15 minutes.
Then, put the sliced boiled eggs and lemon on top of the rice.
Serve while hot! Share and enjoy.

title: Superb Ginataang Mais: 101 Cooking
instructions: Pour 2 cups of water in a casserole.
Put-in the corn and pandan leaves and let it boil for 10 minutes.
Then add the glutinous rice. Stir and cook for about 20 minutes.Note: Stir continuously to avoid the rice to stick on the pan.
Add the sugar, 1 cup of water, and 2 cups of coconut milk. Stir well until it boils.Note: To avoid curdling of the coconut milk, cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve while hot!

title: Superb Beef Tapa Recipe
instructions: Wash the beef meat 2 times with vinegar, then squeeze the beef meat very well.
Put beef meat in a large bowl, then season it with soy sauce, vinegar, salt, ground black pepper, brown sugar, and coke. Mix well.
Add the garlic and mix it again.
Cover the bowl then refrigerate it for 24 hours.
After 24 hours, heat oil in a pan, and fry the seasoned beef meat.
Occasionally stir the meat. After 8 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Adobong Manok sa Buko Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup Green onion (sliced into small pieces)
instructions: In a bowl, combine chicken, soy sauce and vinegar. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan. Saute onion and garlic.
Once onion softens, add marinated chicken. Saute until light brown.
Pour remaining marinade, and then add whole peppercorn, dried bay leaves, and buko juice. Let boil.
Adjust heat to between low to medium and continue to cook for 15 minutes.
Add green onions. Cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Morcon Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Medium carrot (cut into long strips)
1 pc Cheese (cut into strips about 1/2 inch)
instructions: Marinate the beef in soy sauce and lemon juice for at least 1 hour.
Place the beef in a flat surface and arrange the hotdogs, pickle, carrot, cheese, and egg on one side.
Roll the beef enclosing the fillings and tie with a cooking string to ensure that the meat will not open-up.
Place cooking oil in a pan and apply heat.
Dredge the rolled beef in flour and fry until the color of the outer part turns medium brown.
Transfer the fried rolled beef in a casserole and pour-in the beef stock then bring to a boil.
Pour-in half of the soy sauce-lemon juice marinade,salt and simmer until the beef is tender (about 2 hours using ordinary casserole or 30 minutes if a pressure cooker is used).
Optional: Fry the simmered meat for at least 2 minutes.
Remove the strings and slice into serving pieces.
Place in a serving dish and add the sauce.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Rellenong Pusit Recipe
instructions: Combine squid, soy sauce, and juice from 1 piece lemon (squeezed) and marinade for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a cooking pan.
Sauté garlic, onion, celery, and tomato.
Put-in the ground pork and cook until the color turns light brown (about 5 minutes).
Add carrots, salt and ground black pepper then stir. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes. Turn-off heat and let cool.
Stuff the marinated squid with the cooked ground pork. Insert toothpicks at the opening of the squid to secure the filling.
Dip the stuffed squid in beaten egg then dredge in flour. Set aside.
In another pan, heat cooking oil.
Pan-fry the squid. Cook each side for 3 to 5 minutes.Note: Do not overcook the squid so that it will remain tender.
Transfer the cooked squid in a serving plate and serve.

title: Best Meatloaf Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground beef, onion, milk, sugar, and breadcrumbs. Then add the mustard and ketchup. Mix well.
Then season with salt and pepper. Continue mixing.
After mixing, transfer the mixed ingredients in a loaf pan or tray.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and bake for 1 hour.
Remove from the oven and transfer to a serving plate.
Serve. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Kare-Kare Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Beef meat (boiled for 1 hour and cut into 3 inches in length and 2 inches wide)
1 pc Red onion (big and cut into small cubes)
1 pc Banana flower bud (cut into 1-inch rounds)
6 pcs String beans (cut into 3 inches long each pc)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan, saute garlic until golden brown, add onion and saute until softened.
Now add the boiled beef meat and pour in 4 cups of beef broth into the pan. Season it with salt and ground black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour in the annatto mixture (add the liquid only). Stir until boil.
Cover the pan and boil for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, pour in the coconut milk while stirring the mixture continuously. Boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add string beans and banana flower bud. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in eggplant and native bok choy. Simmer again for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, transfer into a serving bowl.
Serve with shrimp paste and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Manok Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan.
Saute the garlic until golden brown, add the onion and ginger. Mix them well.
Put the chicken and pepper, add the fish sauce, mix and cover for 5 minutes.
Add the vinegar and cover again for 2-3 minutes.
Put the papaya, green chilies, water. Mix then cover  and simmer for about 10 minutes
After 10 minutes, add the coconut milk, mix in until the coconut is boiled, after mixing the coconut milk cover and cook it for 10 minutes using low heat.
Then serve it while hot.

title: Best Chicken Adobo Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and pepper. Mix well and marinate chicken legs for at least 1 hour.
After 1 hour, heat the pot and put in the chicken legs with the marinade sauce.
Add the bay leaves and onions. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until chicken is tender already.TIP: You can add more water if the pork is not yet tender.
Set aside the chicken when tender.
Heat oil in another pan, medium fry the chicken. Then, set aside when fried.
Remove some oil from the pan before pouring the sauce & chicken into it.
Simmer for another 2 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!

title: The Recipes of the Best Crab Cake Ever
instructions: In a bowl, put-in the lump or claw meat and season with salt, pepper, seasoning, breadcrumbs, and egg. Mix them well for 10 mins, then refrigerate it while covered for 15 mins.

Then heat oil in a pan (for pan-fried) for 3 mins, mold the mixture like patties and roll them in the flour before directly putting them on the pan. Cook for 2 mins each until it gives you a golden-brown texture. On the other hand, if you are going to bake it, preheat the oven to 400 degrees for 10 mins. Put parchment paper on the pan and put the molded mixture of crab cake on it. Take note that you do not have to roll it in the flour; you just have to make sure that the mixture is refrigerated and thick enough to avoid it from falling apart.
For baking: bake it for 25-30 mins.
Let it rest for 10 mins
Transfer to a serving plate. Eat and enjoy!

title: How To Cook The Perfect Ginataang Tilapia
instructions: In a cooking pan over the stove, put the onion and ginger.Note: Do not turn on the heat yet.
Then cover the tilapia with bok choy and put on the pan over the onion and ginger.
Put-in the remaining onion and ginger over the tilapia. Then sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Pour the vinegar, water and long green chilies then turn on the heat. Cook for about 15 minutes.
Then pour-in coconut milk and stir occasionally to avoid curdling. Once it boils, lower the heat and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Puto Bumbong Recipe
instructions: In a large container, combine rice flour, coconut milk and ube flavouring. Mix well until you form a dough. Set aside.
Fill your puto bumbong steamer with water halfway through. Apply heat and then let the water boil. Set aside.
Prepare bamboo tube and spread butter inside of each tube.
Then, fill each bumbong (bamboo tube) with the mixture. Note: Do not compress the rice so that steam can pass easily.
Once the water starts to boil rapidly, arrange each bamboo tube on the steamer. Continue to cook until steam comes out of the tube.
Remove the tube from the steamer. Arrange the contents over a piece of banana leaf, then top with freshly grated coconut, cheese and sugar.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Calderetang Kambing Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into strips)
1/2 cup Fresh nuts or peanut butter
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the goat meat (chevon) with vinegar, salt and black pepper then marinate for at least an hour. Set aside.Note: Marinating the goat meat for an hour will eliminate the gamey smell.
Pour the cooking oil in a cooking pot or casserole and apply heat.
Saute garlic and onions until brown.
Add the marinated goat meat then cook for 5 minutes or until the color of the outer part turns light brown.
Pour-in tomato sauce and water, and allow to boil. Simmer for 1 hour or until the meat is tender.
Then add the peanut butter and stir well until dissolved.
Add potatoes and carrots then cook for another 20 minutes or until potatoes get tender. Then lower the heat.
Put-in red bell peppers and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve while hot!

title: Best Calamares Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb Squid (medium to large size) (cleaned and sliced into rings)
instructions: Slice squid in half just below the eyes, separating the tentacles from the head; reserve tentacles.
Holding the body, gently pull out the head, intestines, ink sac, and clear skeleton; discard innards.
Working from the cut end of the body, grasp the thin skin. Peel back toward the tip and discard.
Rinse squid body and tentacles before cooking. Slice body crosswise into rings.
In a bowl, combine squid, salt, pepper and calamansi extract. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan.
Dredge the squid in flour then dip in beaten egg and roll over breadcrumbs.
Once the oil is hot, deep fry the squid until the coat turns brown. Note: Do not overcook the squid.
Then, remove the squid from the pan and place on a plate over paper tissue.
Serve with your favorite dip. Eat and enjoy!

title: Best Ginisang Corned Beef Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a cooking pan.
Saute garlic until brown. Then add the onion and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the corned beef and cook for about 5 minutes.
Pour-in water and cook for 5 minutes or until it boils.
Then add the potatoes and sprinkle with salt. Simmer for another 10 minutes.
Transfer into a serving plate. Enjoy!

title: Best Tortang Alamang Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix alamang with salt and pepper, then add scrambled egg and flour. Mix them well together. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, scoop 2 tablespoons of mixture in the pan and form a thin circle.
Fry the alamang 3-5 minutes per side or until crispy brown.
Transfer in a serving plate. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Nilupak Recipe
instructions: In a casserole, boil grated cassava with water for 40 minutes.
Once the cassava is tender, transfer it into a large bowl.
Put-in vanilla, margarine, grated coconut meat and sugar in the bowl.
Then add the sweetened milk and mix very well for 20 minutes.
Place the mixture in a flat tray. Then mold into 1-inch thick.
Slice the molded mixture according to your desired size.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Java Rice Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix rice with salt and pepper. Mix well then set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Saute garlic and onion until brown. Then add the ginger, cook for 2 minutes.
Add rice on the pan, then pour-in annatto oil. Mix gently for 10 minutes.
Ready to serve. Enjoy!

title: Best Palitaw sa Latik Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine 1/2 cup of glutinous powder and water. Then mix them until a smooth dough is formed.
Scoop out about 1½ Tbsp. and form in a small ball. Then flatten into oval shape alt least ¼ inch thick. Set aside.
In a pot, pour 5 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, put the palitaw one by one and simmer until the palitaw rise to the surface of the sauce.
In a pan, simmer the coconut milk, stirring continuously until almost dry and the coconut oil comes out from the curd.
Continue stirring until the curds are separated from the oil and the curds turn to brown but not burned.
Strain the browned curds and set aside.
In a casserole, pour 1 cup of water and 2 cups of coconut milk. Stir until it boils.
Then put-in sugar, latik, cooked palitaw, and the remaining cup of glutinous powder. Simmer until the sauce is slightly thick. Then remove from the heat.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy.

title: Best Homemade Fishball Recipe
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the fish meat with carrots, celery and onion.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add the flour and pour-in the shrimp stock. Stir well for 10 minutes or wait until the mixture gets thick. Set aside.
Heat 3 cups of oil in a pot.
Once the oil is hot enough, scoop a tablespoon of fish mixture and form it round.
Then gently drop them in the pot and fry for 3-5 minutes or until light brown.
Transfer into a serving plate. Serve, share and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Halang Halang Recipe
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot.
Saute the onion, garlic, and ginger until the onion softened.
Add the chicken pieces. Cook until light to medium brown. Turn the meat over to cook the other side.
Add-in the papaya and chili flakes then lower the heat. Cook for about 10 minutes while covered.
Put-in the lemongrass and fish sauce. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
Then gradually pour in the coconut milk and bring to a light simmer for about 15 minutes.Note: Stir thoroughly to avoid curdling of the coconut milk.
Add the malunggay leaves and cook for another 3-5 minutes.
Remove from heat. Garnish with chili leaves before serving.

title: Best Ginataang Kalabasa na may Malunggay
instructions: Heat oil in a cooking pot.
Saute garlic and onion until brown.
Add the shrimp and season with salt. Cook for about 5 minutes.
Then pour-in shrimp stock and bring it to a boil.
Add the coconut milk and stir well until it boils.
Put-in the squash and cover the pan. Cook for another 15 minutes.
Then add the malunggay leaves and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat and transfer into a serving plate
Eat while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Bringhe (Native Paella) Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a cooking pan.
Saute garlic and onion until brown.
Put-in the chicken and liver gizzard. Stir for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, and stir well.
Then pour the chicken stock and cook for another 10 minutes.
Add the turmeric and coconut milk then let it boil over low heat.
Put-in the cooked rice and stir thoroughly to avoid sticking on the pan.
Then add the green peas and raisins. Stir well for 15 minutes or until the rice turns thick.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Pancit Sotanghon Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil is hot, saute garlic and onion until brown.
Add the shrimp and shredded chicken, and cook for 2 minutes.
Then add water, soy sauce and chicken stock  in the pan.
Put-in carrot and pepper and bring to a boil.
Put-in sotanghon noodles and cook for 10 minutes. Make sure that the noodles are soft and that excess water has been drained. Toss until all the ingredients are well blended.
Add the baguio beans and cabbage. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Transfer in serving plate. Enjoy!

title: Best Suman Moron Recipe
instructions: In a pan, combine powdered glutinous rice, evaporated milk, coconut milk, vanilla, and sugar. Mix well over low heat for 10 minutes or until it is smooth enough to mold. Set aside.
In another pan, combine rice powder, powdered glutinous rice, cocoa powder, coffee, salt, coconut milk, evaporated milk, vanilla, and butter. Stir first before placing on heat.
After mixing well, cook the mixture over low heat for 10 minutes.
Let it cool for a moment, then add the peanut into the chocolate mixture.
Place one banana leaf on a flat surface, put 2 tbsp of the plain mixture and chocolate mixture on the center of the banana leaf and shape it by placing together these 2 mixtures.
Roll the banana leaf and tie a string on both sides. Do the same procedure with the remaining mixtures.
Place all wrapped mixture into the steamer and steam it for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, serve and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Pochero Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Chorizo bilbao (cut into thin rounds)
10 pcs Baguio beans (cut into half and the hard part is removed)
3 pcs Plantains (saba banana, cut into 3 pieces each pc.)
1 pc Onion (big and cut into small cubes)
1/4 kg Bok choy (pechay, cut the hard part at the bottom.)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, saute garlic until golden brown, add onion and saute until softened, and then add tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes are softened and crushed.
Now add the beef meat and season it with salt and ground black pepper. Mix until beef meat turned brown. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour the water into the pot, remove the black bubbles the may appear on top of the mixture. Cover and simmer for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, toss in chorizo bilbao and simmer for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add potatoes and carrots. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in the saba banana, green pepper, Baguio beans, and tomato sauce. Bring to boil and add pechay.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Galunggong Recipe
instructions: Pour the coconut milk in a wide cooking pot. Let it boil.
Add the garlic, ginger, onion, fish sauce, and ground black pepper. Stir. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Arrange the fish in the cooking pot along with the Serrano pepper. Cover and then continue cooking in medium heat for 25 minutes.
Remove the cover. Let the sauce reduce to about 1/2 to 3/4 cups.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with warm rice.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Ukoy (Shrimp Fritter) Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups Mung bean sprouts or Togue
instructions: Combine cornstarch, flour, baking powder, egg, water, salt, and ground black pepper then stir until diluted.
Add the shrimps and mung bean sprouts in the mixture and lightly stir to distribute.
Heat a frying pan and pour-in the cooking oil.
Once the oil is hot enough, scoop about 2 to 3 tablespoons of the mixture and quickly (but cautiously) drop it in hot oil.
Cook each side for 2 to 3 minutes or until the color turns golden brown. Repeat this step until the entire mixture is consumed.Note: Cooking time may vary.
Remove the deep-fried ukoy from the pan and place in a plate lined with paper towel to absorb the oil.
Remove the paper towel and serve. Enjoy!

title: The Perfect Lumpiang Shanghai Recipe
ingredients: 3 Cups vegetable, canola, or olive oil
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground pork, onion, carrots, garlic powder, parsley, salt, sesame oil, and eggs. Mix them well.
Scoop around 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of well-mixed filling and place half a handful of it over a lumpia wrapper. Spread the filling in a parallel movement, and then fold both sides of the thin crepe.

Fold the wrapper into two from bottom to top with the filling mixture in the middle. Roll-up until completely wrapped. Brush water or egg mixture on the crepe’s top end to make sure you will seal it tightly. Perform the same step until all mixture is consumed.
Heat oil in a pan, then fry lumpia in medium heat until it floats and turns golden brown.
Please put it on a plate with a paper towel to absorb the excess oil when already cooked.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Superb Pork Adobo with Coconut Milk
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and pepper. Mix well and marinate the pork for at least 1 hour.
Now heat the skillet and put in the marinated pork. Add the remaining ingredients except for the oil.
Mix well the pork mixture and bring it to boil. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes to 1 hour over low heat or until pork is tender already.
Set aside the pork when it is tender, and medium fry it in a separate pan.
Pour the sauce into the pan and then add the pork and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour coconut milk into the pan and stir until it boils. Top it with fresh round onions.
Serve while hot! Share and Enjoy!

title: Superb Creamy Mixed Vegetable Recipe
instructions: Melt the butter in a cooking pan.
Once the butter melts, saute garlic and onion until brown.
Add the shrimp then season with fish sauce and ground black pepper. Stir well.
Then put-in potatoes, carrots, chayote and shredded corn. Cook for about 10 minutes.
Add the green peas, baguio beans, quail eggs and bell pepper. Pour-in nestle cream and melted cornstarch then stir well. Simmer for another 3-5 minutes.
Serve while hot. Enjoy!

title: Superb Ginisang Ampalaya Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Ampalaya (medium sized, seeded, cut into half moons)
1/4 cup water or Pork or Chicken stock
instructions: Put bitter squash/melon in a medium bowl. Sprinkle some salt and add lukewarm water, then set aside for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, place the bitter squash/melon in a clean cloth where you can squeeze it tightly. Squeeze until the water drip-off.
Sauté garlic, onion, and tomatoes. Mash tomatoes mildly. Once mashed, toss in ground pork.
Sprinkle with cracked black pepper and add ¼ cup of water or stock. Please bring it to a boil. Wait for at least 5 minutes.
Then, add bitter squash/melon. Wait for at least 10 minutes or until cooked.Tip: don't mix or stir continuously, as this might add extra bitterness to the dish.
Once the bitter gourd is cooked, pour in scrambled eggs. Stir.
Then turn off the heat.
Serve it hot on a serving plate. Enjoy!

title: Best Sauteed Monggo Recipes
instructions: In a pot, boil the green soy for 30 minutes or until it softens. Set aside.
Sauté garlic until golden brown and add onions and tomatoes. Stir until it crushes.
Put the pork and shrimp. Then add the salt and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.
After that, you can put the fish sauce, add water, and put lemongrass. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add boiled green soy and then stir it carefully for 5 minutes, until it boils.
Lower the heat and add bitter gourd leaves. Then, simmer it for another 2 minutes and turn off the fire.
Afterward, you can now serve it. You can also put some herbs like Kinchay as a garnish or crushed Chicharon on top.
Share and enjoy! Eat while it is warm.

title: Best Ginataang Langka Recipe
instructions: In a pot, boil the jackfruit for 10 minutes. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry the pork meat until lightly browned. Then add the garlic and onions. Saute until softened.
Add the fish sauce and 1/2 cup of water. Stir well until it boils.
Then, add the boiled jackfruit. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Pour 1 cup of coconut milk and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Add the remaining cup of coconut cream and red chilies. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve while hot!

title: Superb Tortang Giniling na Baboy Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Sauté garlic and onion then add the ground pork. Stir well.
Add the black pepper and salt, then add water. Cook for 5 minutes until it boils.
Put the potatoes and carrots. Cook for about 3-5 minutes. Then transfer into a small bowl and let it cool.
Then, combine eggs and flour into it. Mix well.
Heat oil in another pan and fry the mixture until golden brown. Tip: Pour the mixture until it creates a circle shape.
After frying, transfer it into a plate. Ready to serve!

title: Best Spareribs Kaldereta Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
1 pc Carrot (big and cut into cubes)
1 pc Red Bell Pepper (cut into strips)
instructions: In a bowl, season the meat with ground black pepper, soy sauce, and calamansi extract. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pot, saute garlic until golden brown. Add the onion and saute until softened.
Now, add the ribs into the pot. Mix until the ribs turned brown. Season with salt, tomato sauce, and tomato paste. Mix then pour in water. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, add the potatoes, carrot, peanut butter, and liver spread. Simmer for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add the cheese. Bring to boil and off the fire.
Transfer onto a serving plate. Sprinkle with red bell pepper on top.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Bicol Express Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
2 pcs Green Chilies (cut into thin rounds)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute garlic until golden brown.
Then, add the ginger. Mix, then put the chicken breast and cayenne pepper. Continue mixing for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour in coconut milk, stir continuously to avoid the coconut milk from forming.
Now, pour in the chicken broth and green chilies. Simmer for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, transfer into a serving bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Roasted Pork Belly Recipe
instructions: Using a fork, lightly stab the skin of the pork belly.
In a pot, bring water to boil with salt, bay leaves, and whole peppercorn.
When the water is boiling already, put the pork belly into the pot. Simmer for 1 hour. Occasionally turn the meat over.
After 1 hour, transfer the pork belly into a flat surface. Let it cool.
Now, stab the pork skin using a fork again. Rub it with salt and transfer into a wire rack and let it dry using the air coming from an electric fan.
After 1 hour, heat oil in a pan, then put the pork belly into the pan. Occasionally turn the meat over. Fry until golden brown.Tip: Make sure the oil is hot already before frying the pork.
Make slices. Serve with your choice of sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Chicharon Bituka Recipe
instructions: Using a faucet, clean the pork's intestine outside and most especially inside. Make sure to remove everything that's in the pork's intestine.
Boil water in a large pot. Then, pour it on the pig's intestine after the 1st part of washing.
Let it cool, and clean it again using water from the faucet.
Now, rub it with salt and vinegar to remove the stinky smell of the intestine. Then, wash it again.
Prepare water with alum crystal in a basin.
Now, cut the pork's intestine into rounds and soak it into the basin with water and alum crystal for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, wash the pork's intestine and transfer it into a pot.
Season it with salt, ground black pepper, and vinegar. Cover and boil for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, drain and set aside the pork's intestine.
Heat oil in a pot, fry the pork's intestine until half-cooked. Then transfer it into a bowl, refrigerate for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, heat oil in a pan, and fry the pork's intestine until golden brown.
Transfer onto a serving plate. Serve with sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Sarciadong Manok Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, saute the onion until softened. Then, add tomatoes and garlic. Mix until the tomatoes softened.
Now, put the chicken, season it with fish sauce, ground black pepper, and laurel leaves. Mix until chicken turned brown.
Pour the chicken broth into the pot and also add the parsley. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes over low heat.
After 20 minutes, toss in green peas. Simmer.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Spicy Chicken Feet Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Chicken Feet (cut the nails and remove the hard skin,)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, and then fry the chicken feet until golden brown.
After frying, remove some oil from the pan. Now saute garlic until golden brown. Then add ginger.
Mix then add the chicken feet, season it with soy sauce, oyster sauce, and black beans. Mix well.
Now, add young onion and pour in the water. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes over low heat.
After 45 minutes, add the chili powder. Simmer and stir, then add the diluted corn starch.
Simmer. Then, transfer onto a serving plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Inihaw Na Panga Ng Tuna Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl, marinate the tuna jaws in soy sauce, garlic, cayenne pepper, calamansi, and ground black pepper. Mix well, then add the brown sugar. Mix well again.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for one day.
Grill the jaw on the griller and brush it with marinade sauce you used in marinating the fish.
Turn the fish over and over occasionally for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, transfer onto a serving plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Sapsap Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Small Flat Fish (sapsap) (big and cleaned)
2 pcs Red Onion (medium and cut into strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute the onion until softened. Then, add the garlic, ginger and cayenne pepper. Mix.
Now, pour in the coconut milk and water. Stir until boil.
Then, add the vinegar, salt, and green chilies. Cover and simmer for 2 minutes.
After 2 minutes, add the fish. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the spinach leaves and simmer again for the last 5 minutes.
Transfer into a serving bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Mackerel Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute onion until softened, then add the garlic and ginger. Mix.
Now, add cayenne pepper and pour in the coconut milk. Stir until boil.
Add the mackerel, vinegar, fish sauce, and ground black pepper. Cover and bring it to boil.
Add the spinach. Stir.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Seafood Kare-Kare Recipe
ingredients: 5 pcs Sting Beans (cut into 3 inches in length )
instructions: Heat half of the oil in a pan, half-fry all the seafood ingredients. Set aside the fried seafood and the oil.
Pour the remaining oil in a pot, saute garlic until golden brown. Then, add the onion mix until softened.
Now, pour the coconut milk into the pot. Stir until boil.
When it's boiling already, put the annatto extract into the pot and sprinkle with salt.
Then, add the seafood and pour in the oil used in frying the seafood ingredients into the pot.
Now, dilute the peanut butter into a little amount of water.
Add the string beans, banana bell, and peanut butter into the pot. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, transfer onto a serving bowl.
Serve with shrimp paste and enjoy!

title: Best Chili Crab With Snake Beans
ingredients: 8 pcs Sting Beans (cut into 2 inches in length each pc)
instructions: In a bowl, combine chicken broth, soy sauce, and corn starch. Stir then add ketchup. Mix well and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan, saute garlic until golden brown.
Now, add onion and ginger. Saute until onion softened. Then add the crabs and season it with salt and ground black pepper. Continue mixing for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour in the chicken broth while continuously stirring. Stir until the sauce thickened.
Now, add the beaten egg and mix until the egg is cooked.
Transfer onto a serving plate. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Liver Steak Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine pork liver, calamansi, black pepper and soy sauce. Marinate for 1 hour. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry the liver until color turns golden brown.
On the same pan with the remaining oil, sauté garlic. Add the fried liver, cornstarch, and pour in the marinade sauce.
Put the onions in the pan. Simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve while hot!

title: Best Chicken And Broccoli Stir Fry Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, season chicken with soy sauce, 1/4 tsp salt, and egg white. Mix well.
Heat oil in a pan, cook the marinated chicken until lightly brown. Transfer chicken into a bowl and set aside.
In a small bowl, combine oyster sauce, olive oil, cornstarch, 1 1/2 tbsp water, and sugar. Mix and set aside.
Pour the water into a pot, bring to boil, and use the boiling water to clean the broccoli using a strainer.
In the same pan, add 1 tsp oil and saute garlic until lightly brown. Add garlic, mix, and add the corn starch mixture into the pan.
Mix the corn starch mixture until sauce turned sticky.
Now add the broccoli and chicken and mix for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the wine and transfer it into a serving plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Bitsuelas Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute onion until softened. Then, add the garlic and ginger. Mix.
Now, add the ground pork. Mix well.
Season the mixture with ground black pepper and shrimp paste. Cook for 10 minutes over low heat.
After 10 minutes, pour in the coconut milk. Stir until boil.
Now, add the green beans. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the spinach leaves. Bring to boil.
Transfer into a serving bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Braised Vegetables Recipe
ingredients: 1 cup Bamboo Shoot (fresh and cut into strips)
instructions: Boil 4 cups of water in a pot. Then, blanch the peas for 2 minutes. Then soak it into the water with ice.
Heat oil in a pan, saute garlic until golden brown.
Then, add the onion until softened. Add the ground black pepper, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Mix then add the carrot. Mix well.
Now, add the young corn and bamboo shoots. Mix, then add the mushroom, salt, and brown sugar. Mix and cover. Cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in the peas. Mix well.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Tuyo Pesto Spaghetti Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 kg Spaghetti Pasta (cooked according to the package instructions)
5 pcs Dried Fish (shredded and dispose the head and bone)
instructions: Blend basil leaves, 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, pine nuts, garlic and half of the virgin oil in a blender for 5 minutes or until everything is crushed.
In a bowl, combine spaghetti pasta and pesto mixture. Then, add the shredded dried fish and the remaining parmesan cheese.
Slowly mix all the mixtures together. Tip: You can add 2 tbsp of warm water to mix it easily.
Now, transfer onto a serving plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Kilawing Kambing Recipe
ingredients: 3 pcs Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Pour in water and lemon juice in a pot and boil the lamb's meat for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, cut the meat into wide slices and grill it.
Now, cut the meat into thin slices and put it into a bowl. Add the onion, ginger, cayenne pepper, salt, ground black pepper, vinegar, calamansi, and sugar. Mix well.
Serve and Enjoy!

title: Best Seaweed Salad Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Tomatoes (medium and cut into cubes)
instructions: Boil water in a pot, then put the seaweed and continue 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, drain and transfer it into a bowl. Season it with salt and refrigerate it for 10 minutes.
In the meantime, get a bowl and combine vinegar, ground black pepper, tomatoes, onion, and cucumber. Mix then pour it into the bowl with seaweed.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Shrimp Avocado Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Avocado (ripe and cut into cubes)
1 pc Red Bell Pepper (cut into cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, season shrimp with a scant of salt and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Heat oil in a pan, fry the shrimp just for a moment. Then set aside.
Put the Chinese parsley, virgin oil, honey, lemon juice, salt, and ground black pepper in a blender. Blend for 5 minutes. Set aside
In a bowl, arrange lettuce, Mexican turnip, red bell pepper, and tomatoes. Now, add half of the shrimp onto the bowl.
Then, add avocado, and pour Chinese parsley mixture into the bowl. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, serve and enjoy!

title: Best Kielbasa Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 pcs Jumbo Brown Hotdog (cut into thin slices and fried)
1 pc Carrot (small and cut into cubes)
1 pc Potato (peeled and cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a pan, saute carrot, potato, and green peas for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add the hotdogs and egg. Mix well.
Now, add the steamed rice and season it with salt and ginger powder. Mix well for 5 minutes over low heat.
Transfer onto a serving plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Custard Cake Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees F.
Put a pan inside the oven and melt the sugar or until caramelized. Remove from the oven and set aside.
In a bowl, combine, egg yolk, evaporated milk, and condensed milk. Mix well.
Then, pour it into the baking pan with caramelized sugar. Place the pan on a larger baking pan and pour water on the larger pan. Bake it for 20 minutes.
In a mixing bowl, combine sugar with egg yolk. Mix well.
Now add baking powder. Mix again.
Then, slowly add the flour into the bowl. Add the grated lemon zest. Set aside.
Use an electric mixer to beat the white eggs in another bowl. Then, add the cream of tartar. Mix for 10 minutes with sugar until fluffy.
Now, carefully mix the cake mixture into the bowl. Mix using a spatula.
Now, pour the cake mixture into the baking pan with custard mixture.
Put it inside the oven over a tray with water.
Bake the mixture for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, check it the cake using a toothpick and if it came out clean, it means it's cooked already.
Remove it from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, turn the custard cake over a wide tray to get the custard cake from the baking pan.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Banana Bread Recipe
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, put the crushed banana, add sugar, and egg. Mix well.
Now, pour in the milk, add flour, and baking soda. Mix well.
Brush the rectangular baking dish with oil. Then fill it with the banana bread mixture.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Bake the mixture for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, make slices. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Vanilla Chiffon Cake
instructions: Separate the egg yolk for white in a separate bowl.
Beat well the egg yolk until softened.
Then add the oil, vanilla, 1 cup of sugar, salt, royal, corn starch, baking powder, and flour. Mix well and set aside.
Use an electric mixer to beat the egg white, while mixing the sugar slowly onto the egg white for 10 minutes or until fluffy.
Then, pour the egg yolk mixture onto the egg white mixture and mix it using a spatula. Mix well.
Preheat oven to 160 degrees C.
Fill the round baking dish with the mixture and bake it for 55 minutes.Tip: Don't open the oven for 55 minutes.
After 55 minutes, remove the cake from the oven. Let it cool for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, make slices. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Roast Beef Recipe
instructions: Make incisions around the beef using a knife. Then, put the garlic inside the cuts.
Then rub it with oil, salt, and ground black pepper.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Then, place the beef over the wire rack and place the wire rack onto the baking tray.
Bake the beef for 2 hours. Then, remove the beef from the oven. Let it cool.
Pour the wine onto the baking tray, so you can get the dripping sauce from the beef.
Transfer the beef sauce into a pot. Then, pour in the water, beef stock, and slowly pour the diluted corn starch. Stir until sauce thickened.
Slice the beef into serving pieces. Serve with sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Utan Bisaya (Boiled Vegetables) Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Daing Na Bangus (fried and cut into 4 pieces)
1 pc Silk Squash (patola) (peeled and cut into rounds)
5 pcs String Beans (cut into 3 inches in length each string)
instructions: Boiled water in a pot. Then, add ginger, squash, and simmer for 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, toss in string beans, green chili, and okra. Simmer for another 3 minutes.
Then, add the eggplant. Bring to boil, then add malunggay leaves and daing na bangus. Bring to boil.
Now, add silk squash and simmer for 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, toss in spinach leaves. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, transfer into a serving bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Fish Fillet With Tausi
instructions: In a bowl, season fish fillet with salt and 1/2 tsp of ground black pepper.
Heat oil in a pan. Then, roll the fish fillet onto the flour.
Now, fry the fish fillet until golden brown. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pot, saute garlic until golden brown. Then, add onion, ginger, and tomato. Mix until softened.
Toss in fermented black beans and season it with soy sauce and ground black pepper. Mix it again.
Then, pour in the water, vinegar, and sugar. Brint it to boil.
Now, add the fish fillet and pour the diluted corn starch into the pot. Simmer.
Transfer onto a serving plate, and top it with young onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sweet And Sour Tilapia Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Onion (medium and cut into strips)
2 tbsp Corn Starch (diluted in 1/2 cup of water)
instructions: Cut each side of the fish. Then put 1/2 tsp salt inside of the fish cut.
Heat oil in a pan, fry the fish until golden brown.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil in another pan, saute onion, tomato, carrot, and ginger. Mix until softened.
Pour the water, ketchup, and sprinkle it with salt, ground black pepper.
Mix until the mixture boils.
Then, pour in the vinegar and add sugar.
Now, pour the diluted corn starch into the pan.
Then, carefully add the fish. Simmer for 2 minutes only.
Transfer onto a serving plate and top it with bell pepper and young onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Huevos Rancheros Recipe
ingredients: 4 pcs Tomatoes (big, slightly fried and peeled)
2 pcs White Onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Using a blender, mix tomatoes, Chinese parsley, garlic, and green chili. Add 2 tbsp of water. Blend for 5 minutes.
After blending, transfer it into a pot and simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, arrange the tortilla in a wide serving plate. Put an egg on each tortilla and pour the tomato mixture on the tortillas with fried eggs.
Top it with white onion. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Carrot Cake Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Carrot (blend the carrot until totally crushed)
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Set aside.
Beat the eggs using a hand mixer. Beat it well, then add sugar, orange juice, and oil.
After mixing, slowly add the flour mixture.
Add the blended carrots. Mix it well.
Brush the round baking dish with a bit of oil, then pour the carrot mixture.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Bake the carrot cake mixture for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, check the cake using a toothpick and if it came out clean it means it's cook already.
Make slices and enjoy!

title: Best Chocolate Cupcake Recipe
instructions: Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and cocoa powder in a bowl.
Now, add the sugar. Mix well.
Then add water, oil, egg, and vinegar. Beat the mixtures well.
Prepare the cupcake molder, and put each cupcake molder with baking paper.
Then fill the cupcake cups 3/4 full.
Preheat oven to 180 degrees C.
Bake the cupcake for 20 minutes or until the inserted toothpick came out clean.
Serve with your choice of drink and enjoy!

title: Best Baked King Crab Legs With Garlic Lemon Butter Sauce
instructions: In a pot with water, boil the king crab legs for 5 minutes.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat, saute garlic. Then pour in the lemon juice.
Add olive oil, parsley, and salt. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, arrange the crab legs onto the tray and brush it with lemon mixture.
Preheat oven to 250 degrees F.
Bake the crab legs for 10 minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Pancit Cabagan
ingredients: 3 pcs White onion (2 pcs; cut into rounds, 1 pc; chopped)
1 pc Carrot (big and cut into strips)
1 cup Baguio leeks (cut into thin rounds)
1/2 kg Pork belly (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan, saute garlic until golden brown, add onion and saute until softened.
Now add the pork belly and season it with soy sauce and ground black pepper, and then pour 2 cups of pork broth into the pan. Boil for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, transfer the pork belly into a bowl. Set aside.
Toss in oyster sauce and carrot then pour the remaining broth into the pan. Boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the miki noodles, stir and boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, transfer the pancit onto a wide serving bowl, sprinkle it with Baguio leeks, cracked chicharong baboy, round onions, and sliced egg.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Crown Roast of Lamb
instructions: Make cuts on the meat side of the ribs, then season it with thyme, garlic, ground black pepper, olive oil, and salt.
Slightly cut the part between the bone of the ribs.
Shape the ribs upward to make a round shape.
Bind the meat to make it look like a crown.
Preheat oven to 300 degrees F.
Then, bake the lamb ribs for 20 minutes or until medium-rare.
After 20 minutes, make slices.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Tortang Talong With Giniling Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Potato (peeled and cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, saute garlic until golden brown. Toss in onion and saute until softened.
Now, add ground pork into the pan and continue mixing to avoid sticking over low heat for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in potato, and cook for another 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, pour in 1/4 cup of water. Cover and simmer until pork is slightly dried already. Transfer the ground pork into a bowl and set aside.
Get the bowl with ground pork, add 3 eggs and flour into the bowl and mix it well with the ground pork.
In a bowl, beat the remaining egg.
Use a spoon to push down the eggplant to flatten and widen it.
Now, dip the eggplant into the beaten egg then add 2 tbsp of ground pork mixture onto the eggplant.
Then, fry it over low heat 5 minutes each side of the eggplant.
Serve on a plate and enjoy!

title: Best Ube Halaya Recipe
instructions: Melt butter in a pan. Then, pour coconut milk and evaporated milk into the pan.
Now, add brown sugar, vanilla, and grated taro fruit. Stir for 15 to 25 minutes or until the mixture thickened already over low heat.
Brush the llanera with butter. Then shape the ube halaya into the llanera.
Serve as a dessert and enjoy!

title: Best Molo Soup Recipe
ingredients: 4 cloves Garlic (minced and sauteed until golden brown)
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground pork, shrimp, onion, egg, garlic powder, ground black pepper, salt, and olive oil. Mix well and set aside.
In the meantime, boil chicken breast in a pot with 4 cups of water for 20 minutes.
While waiting for the chicken breast, make the pork dumpling.
Get 1 molo wrapper and put 1 tbsp of ground pork mixture then fold it.
Do the same process with the remaining ground pork mixture.
After 20 minutes, remove the chicken breast from the pot. Let it cool.
Shred the chicken breast, then toss it back into the pot.
Now, drop all the pork dumplings into the pot.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, season it with fish sauce and put the young onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Inihaw Na Pusit Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, combine onion, tomato, ginger, and Chinese parsley. Season it with salt, ground black pepper, and calamansi juice. Mix well.
Stuffed the squid with the mixture in the bowl.
Grill the squid and avoid overcooking the squid. As this may harden the meat.
Serve hot with your choice of dip and enjoy!

title: Best Nilasing Na Hipon Recipe
instructions: Season shrimp with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp ground black pepper, gin, and garlic. Set aside for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, drain and set aside the shrimp.
Heat oil in a pan, and combine flour, salt, ground black pepper, and corn starch for coating.
Roll each shrimp onto the flour mixture. Fry the shrimp until golden brown.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Lauya Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Beef Meat (cut into serving pieces)
instructions: Combine broth and water in a pot, toss in beef meat. Bring to boil and skim the scum.
When it's already boiling, season it with ginger, pepper, garlic powder, and onion.
Simmer for 1 hour or until beef is tender.
Toss in young onion. Mix and ladle into a bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sinigang Na Bangus Sa Bayabas Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Milkfish  (cleaned and cut into 4 pieces)
2 pcs Taro Fruit (peeled and cut into 3 pieces each)
instructions: Pour 2 cups of water in a pot, then put the guava. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, use a strainer or clean cloth to extract the juice from the guava. Set aside the guava juice.
In another pot, pour 4 cups of water, sprinkle with salt and bring to boil.
When it's boiling already, toss in taro fruit. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add onion, okra, eggplant, and green chili. Simmer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in swamp cabbage leaves, sugar, and guava juice. Simmer.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken With Mushroom Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, season chicken with ground black pepper and salt. Set aside for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, heat oil in a pan and fry both sides of the chicken until lightly brown.
After frying all sliced chicken, melt butter in the same pan then add mushroom and mix again.
Now add the flour and mix for 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, slowly pour the milk into the pan while stirring the mixture continuously. Bring to boil.
When the milk mixture is already boiling you can now pour the chicken broth into the pan, then add the chicken and parmesan. Cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Bukayo Recipe
instructions: In a pan, combine Buko strings, brown sugar, and muscovado sugar. Stir continuously for 20 minutes.
When bukayo mixture becomes sticky enough to be molded in shape, you can now transfer it onto a tray with banana leaves.
Shape the bukayo mixture into small rounds, serve and enjoy!

title: Superb Gotong Batangas Recipe
instructions: Use a large boiling pot, pour water. Bring to boil.
Put all the beef tripes ingredients—cover and cook on medium heat for 30 minutes.
Remove the water, replace with rice wash in the pot. Bring to boil.
Add salt, peppercorn, garlic powder, onion, chili,  Lemongrass, and add annatto paste. Then, stir.
Please put in beef bouillon—simmer over low heat for 4 hours. Add water if needed.
Get the tripes, and slice them into small serving pieces.
Please put them in a bowl. Top with spring onion and chili.
Serve with a dipping sauce, chopped onion, soy sauce, Calamansi, and chili.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Tinolang Manok / Chicken Broth- Base Recipes
ingredients: 1 pc White onion (white, peeled and sliced thinly)
1 pc Green papaya or chayote (Small, pared, seeded and cut into 2-inch wedges)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat.
Saute onions, ginger, and garlic until softened and aromatic.
Put in chicken and cook. Stir occasionally for about 5 to 7 minutes or until chicken starts to change color and produce juices.
Then add fish sauce and cook, stir occasionally for about 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour water and bring to a boil, remove scum that floats on top. Cover and simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes or until chicken is cooked over low heat.
Put in papaya or chayote and cook for about 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Add chili leaves and simmer for the last 1-2 minutes.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Superb Chicken Inasal Menu
instructions: Put and combine chicken, lemongrass, salt, ground black pepper, ginger, garlic, brown sugar, vinegar, lemon-lime soda, and lemon juice In a resealable bag or large bowl.
Stir or shake until ingredients are well mixed. Refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours.
For the basting, put margarine, annatto oil, salt and lemon or calamansi juice in a separate bowl. Then, stir. Set aside.
Light the charcoal and wait until embers appear on the charcoal.
Grill the chicken for 20 minutes or until well done and baste generous amount of the basting sauce.
Transfer the grilled chicken onto a serving plate.
Serve with hot rice. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Paksiw na Bangus Recipe
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs Milkfish (scaled and sliced crosswise into serving pieces)
instructions: In the pot, put and arrange ginger, garlic, long green chilies, cracked black pepper and eggplant.
Arrange milkfish slices on top.
Add water and vinegar. Cover and cook on medium to low heat for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, sprinkle with salt to taste.
Transfer onto a serving plate.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Superb Adobo with Kangkong Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and pepper. Mix well and marinate pork belly for at least 1 hour.
Heat the pot and put the marinade mixture and marinated pork belly.
Toss in bay leaves and onions. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until pork is tender already.TIP: You can add more water if the pork is not yet tender.
Set aside the pork when tender.
Heat oil in another pan, medium fry the pork. Then, set aside when fried.
Remove some oil from the pan before pouring the sauce & pork into it.
After pouring the sauce and the pork, toss in the water spinach and simmer for another 2 minutes.
Serve with steamed rice and enjoy!

title: Superb Pork Adobo with Potatoes
ingredients: 3 pcs Potatoes (regular size, cut into small squares)
1 pc Onion (peeled and sliced thinly, optional)
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and pepper. Mix well and marinate the pork belly for at least 1 hour.
After 1 hour, add the remaining ingredients into the bowl with marinated pork except for oil and potatoes.
Now heat the pan and pour the pork belly mixture into the pan, cover and bring to boil. Lower the heat when the mixture is boiling already.

Simmer for 40 minutes or until the pork is tender. Then add potatoes and simmer again for another 5-10 minutes. You can add more water if the pork belly is not yet tender after an hour.Tip: Occasionally check potatoes to avoid overcooking.
Set aside the pork and potatoes, and medium fry first the potatoes in a separate pan and set aside. Next, cook the pork in the same pan.
Once the pork is cooked already, pour the sauce into the pan and add the medium fried potatoes and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve while hot! Share and Enjoy!

title: Superb Bicol Express Cuisine
ingredients: 2 pounds  pork belly (cut into 1-inch cubes or strips)
14 pcs Thai chili peppers (stemmed and minced)
instructions: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Sauté onions and garlic. Mix occasionally until softened.
Put in pork and cook. Stir occasionally until lightly browned.
Add shrimp paste and stir occasionally for about 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and water, and add chili peppers. Simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes or until pork is tender and liquid is reduced. Wait until fats begin to meltdown.
Add long green chilies and stir for about 1 to 2 minutes.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve while hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Pork Adobo Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, garlic, and pepper. Mix well and marinate pork belly for at least 1 hour.
Heat the skillet and put in the marinated pork belly.
Toss in bay leaves and onions. Cover the skillet and simmer for 40 minutes or until pork is tender already.TIP: You can add more water if the pork is not yet tender.
Set aside the pork when tender.
Heat oil in another pan, medium fry the pork. Transfer pork into a bowl and set aside.
Remove some oil from the pan before pouring the sauce & pork into it.
Simmer for the last 2 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Kinilaw Na Tanigue Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Boneless Spanish mackerel (cut into small cubes)
4 pcs Green chili (cut into thin rounds)
6 pcs Cayenne pepper (cut into thin rounds)
instructions: In a bowl, marinate boneless tanigue in 1 cup of vinegar for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, squeeze the fish meat to remove the excess vinegar and transfer into a bowl.
Now add onion, green chili, remaining vinegar, salt, ground black pepper, sugar, cayenne, ginger, and calamansi juice. Mix well.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Yang Chow Recipe
ingredients: 4 cups Cooked rice (for best result use day-old rice)
1 cup Barbecue pork (cooked and cut into small cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute garlic until golden brown, add ginger. Mix then pour the beaten egg into the pan, make a quick stir, so it won't form a whole egg.
Toss in shrimp, then mix it well again.
Now add the cooked rice. Season it with soy sauce, salt, sugar, and barbecue pork. Mix it again for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add green peas and young onion. Now give the ingredients a stir fry and mix well.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Goto Recipe
instructions: In a pot, boil beef tripe for 1 1/2 hours over low heat or until tender.
When the beef tripe is tender already, let it cool. Then, transfer onto a flat surface and cut it into serving pieces.
In another pot, saute garlic until golden brown. Then, transfer half of the sauteed onion on a small plate and set aside for garnish.
Now, toss in the onion and saute until softened, add ginger, mix then add the beef tripe and season it with salt and ground black pepper.
Pour in the beef broth and the liquid that was used in boiling the beef tripe.
Wash the glutinous rice with water and then toss it in the pot. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until glutinous rice softened.
After 20 minutes, ladle goto in each bowl. Top it with fried garlic and chopped young onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Shrimp Scampi Pasta Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Shrimp (big, peeled, and set aside the shrimp tails for garnishing.)
1/4 kg Spaghetti pasta (cooked according to package directions)
instructions: Heat olive oil and melt the butter in a pan until slightly brown, toss in grated lemon peel, salt, and lemon juice. Mix for 5 minutes and then add the shrimp into the pan. Mix until the color of the shrimp turned pink.
Put the cooked pasta into a large plate, place the shrimp on top of the pasta and then pour the sauce on top,
Sprinkle it with parsley on top, Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Yellow Fin Tuna
ingredients: 1/2 kg Yellow fin tuna (Cleaned and cut into rounds)
instructions: In a pan, arrange the fish and season it with onion, ginger, green chili, salt, and ground black pepper then pour the vinegar into the pan. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour the coconut milk into the pan, continue stirring until boil.
Cover and simmer for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Palitaw Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, put the powdered glutinous rice. Slowly pour 1 cup of water onto the powdered glutinous rice.
If the glutinous rice mixture can be shaped into palitaw already then you don't need to add water.
Boil water in a pot and carefully drop each palitaw mixture into the pot.
If the palitaw mixture went up  it means it's cooked already.
Roll all cooked palitaw onto shredded coconut and sprinkle it with white sugar.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Tupig Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine powdered glutinous rice, coconut milk, young coconut strips, and sugar. If the mixture is not that sticky add more powdered glutinous rice.
Add 1/2 cup of mixture in the center of the banana leaf and wrap it by rolling and fold the edges to avoid dripping. The size of the output should be 1 inch wide and 6 inches long.
Do the same procedure with the remaining mixture.
Light up the charcoal in a griller, and put the wrapped tupig mixture on the griller, but make sure that ember is already present on the charcoal before you start grilling.
Grill each side of tupig for 3 minutes.
Once the banana leaf is charred on all sides remove the tupig from the grill.
Let it cool for a while. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Mango Shrimp Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Mango (large and cut into cubes)
1 pc Tomato (big and cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, season shrimp with 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, and lemon juice. Cover the bowl and refrigerate.
Heat olive oil and melt butter in a skillet, saute garlic until brown.
Now add onion, ginger, and tomato. Mix until softened.
Add now the mango and season it with sage and cumin. Mix for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the shrimp into the skillet and continue mixing for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes. transfer onto a serving plate and enjoy!

title: Best Pork And Chicken Guisantes Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute garlic until lightly brown.
Add onion and saute until softened.
Now add in the pork and chicken meat and continue mixing until brown.
Season the meat mixture with salt, ground black pepper, and pour in the chicken and beef broth and add tomato sauce.
Boil for 45 minutes over low heat. After 45 minutes, add green peas and simmer for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add bell pepper and mix.
Serve in a serving bowl and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Sinigang Sa Sampalok Recipe
ingredients: 1 bunch Water spinach (get the leaves only)
instructions: Boil the tamarind and set aside.
In a large pot, boil the beef bones and remove the bubbles appearing on top.
Add salt, and ground black pepper. Boil for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, add onion, tomatoes then cover and boil for another 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, check if the meat is still hard if so, boil it for another 30 minutes.
Now add radish, string beans, green chili, okra, and eggplant. Boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, extract the juice from the tamarind by squeezing it. Then get 1 1/2 cup tamarind juice and pour it into the pot.
Add the water spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Ginataang Curacha Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Spanner crab (boiled, clean, and cut into half.)
1 pc White onion (big and cut into cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute onion until softened, and then add ginger and garlic. Mix then pour the coconut milk and season with salt and ground black pepper. Continue stirring until boil.
Now add the spanner crab and cover. Bring to boil.
You can now add cayenne pepper, turmeric, and spinach leaves. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, transfer onto a serving plate, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Minatamis Na Saging Recipe
instructions: In a pot, pour water and add pandan leaf, bring to boil. When it's boiling already, add the peeled bananas, cover, and boil for another 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add sugar, cover, and boil for 10 minutes over low heat or until sauce is already sticky.
After 10 minutes, serve in a bowl and enjoy!

title: Best Kinilaw Na Tuna Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Tuna (Boneless, cut into cubes and cleaned)
2 pcs Green chili (cut into thin rounds)
instructions: In a large bowl, pour in half of the vinegar then add the sliced tuna. Mix well and set aside for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, remove the tuna meat from the bowl and squeeze it to remove the excess vinegar.

Now transfer the tuna cubes into another bowl and season it with cayenne pepper, remaining vinegar, salt, ground black pepper, calamansi juice, sugar, and ginger. Mix well and top it with green chili. Serve with your choice of liquor and enjoy!

title: Best Espasol Recipe
instructions: In a skillet, put glutinous rice and toast until lightly brown over low heat, when it turned lightly brown already separate 1/2 cup for dusting.
In a separate pan, combine coconut milk, white sugar, vanilla, and salt. Bring to boil and slowly add the toasted glutinous flour. Continue stirring the mixture for 15 minutes.
When the mixture is sticky enough then it's cook already.
Now spread half of the toasted glutinous rice onto a tray then add the Espasol mixture.
Divide the mixture into parts or sizes according to your preference.
Then spread the remaining toasted glutinous flour on top of the Espasol.
Let it cool. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Sinigang Na Lapu-Lapu Sa Miso
ingredients: 1 pc White onion (cut into big strips)
1/2 kg Mustard (get only the leaves and cleaned)
instructions: Clean the grouper and slice the belly. Season with 1/4 tsp salt and fry it until lightly brown in a pan.
Heat oil in a pot, saute ginger, onion, and tomatoes until the mixture softened.
Now add miso and radish. Mix well and season it with the remaining salt and pour the water. Boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in the fried grouper, green chili, and mustard leaves. Bring to boil then add the tamarind juice. Bring to boil for a minute.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Baked Creamy Spaghetti Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc White onion  (cut into thin cubes)
instructions: Cook the spaghetti pasta according to package directions in a pot.
When spaghetti is cook already, drain and transfer into a bowl.
Mix the spaghetti pasta with butter, mayonnaise, ground black pepper, and nutmeg. Mix well and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, saute onion until softened, add garlic and mix. Now add the mushroom and carrots. Mix it again then pour the spaghetti sauce into the pot. Add oregano powder, ground black pepper, basil powder. Continue mixing for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour the milk into the pot and add mayonnaise. Cook it again for another 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add red bell pepper.
Prepare the baking dish and make the 1st layer by pouring some of the spaghetti sauce mixture into the baking dish, spread the sauce equally.
Now arrange the spaghetti sauce into the baking dish and pour the remaining spaghetti sauce mixture on top of the spaghetti pasta evenly.
Sprinkle it with parmesan cheese. Preheat oven to 250 degrees F.
Bake the spaghetti mixture for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Suwam Na Tahong
ingredients: 1 pc Onion (big and cut into strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, saute garlic until golden brown, add onion and ginger, saute until mixture softened.
Toss in fresh mussels and season it with salt and ground black pepper. Mix well and cover. Cook for 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, pour the water into the pot, and then add cayenne pepper leaves.
Cover and boil for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, stir the mixture.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Arroz Valenciana Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Onion (medium and cut into strips)
2 pcs Tomatoes (medium and cut into cubes)
instructions: In a large skillet, saute garlic until golden brown, add onion, tomatoes and mix until softened.
Now add the chicken meat, mix until brown.
When the chicken is brown already, season it with salt, ground black pepper, then pour chicken broth and coconut milk into the skillet.
Combine glutinous rice and common rice in a bowl and then wash and filter.
Now add the rice mixture into the skillet. Cover and boil for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add tomato paste, saffron, green peas, and raisin. Mix and cover for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, remove the skillet cover and add red chili on top. Cover and cook for another 15 minutes over low heat.
After 15 minutes, check if the rice is cooked already if so, add the sliced boiled egg on top.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Mexican Meatball Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs White onion (cut into small cubes)
2 pcs Tomatoes (large and cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a large bowl, season ground beef with garlic powder, salt, ground black pepper, white onion, Chinese parsley. Mix well.
Now shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 inch in diameter. Set aside the meatballs.
In a pot, combine beef broth and water, season it with salt and ground black pepper. Bring to boil.
Now drop the meatballs into the pot one at a time. Let it boil.
In the meantime, heat olive oil in a pan, saute onion for 3 minutes, add the tomatoes and garlic. Mix well then add the cooked rice into the pan and mix for another 3 minutes.
After 3 minutes, add the rice mixture into the meatballs mixture, then add potatoes, carrot, and celery. Boil for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, add tomato sauce, coriander seed, and cilantro. Cook for 10 minutes.
Ladle soup with about 5 meatballs in a bowl.
Garnish with lime wedges and warm tortillas.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sinigang Na Bangus Sa Miso Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Milkfish (slice into 4 pieces and cleaned)
2 pcs Tomatoes (medium and cut into strips)
1 pc Radish (cut into 1 inch in diameter)
2 pcs Taro fruit (cut into big slices)
instructions: Boil tamarind in a pot for 5 minutes with 1 cup of water. After 5 minutes, set aside
In another pot, pour the water and add miso. Mix until miso melted.
Now add onion, tomatoes, and ginger. Boil for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add taro fruit and radish. Boil for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add milkfish and boil for 5 minutes.
In the meantime, crush the boiled tamarind and filter.
Now add the water spinach and green chili into the pot then boil again for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add salt and the filtered boiled tamarind. Boil for 2 minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Pinaputok Na Tilapia Recipe
ingredients: 4 pcs Tomatoes (big. 2 pcs cut into cubes/2 pcs cut into rounds)
2 pcs Onion (1 pc cut into rounds/1 pc cut into cubes)
2 thumbs Ginger (1 thumb sliced thinly/1 thumb cut into small cubes)
instructions: Stuff the 2 pcs cubes of tomato, onion, and ginger into 4 tilapia bellies.
Place tilapia onto aluminum foil and top each tilapia with the remaining tomato, onion, and ginger.
Make sure to rub the tilapia fish with salt and ground black pepper.
Wrap the tilapia in an aluminum foil. Make sure that everything is covered.
Transfer all tilapia onto the baking tray.
Heat oven for 170 degrees F.
Bake the fish for 20 minutes. After 20 minutes remove tilapia from the oven.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Buchi Recipe
instructions: In a pot, bring water to boil. When the water is boiling already, remove from heat and add the sugar. Stir until sugar melted.
In a bowl, put 1 1/2 cup glutinous powder then pour the sugar mixture into the bowl. Mix well.
Now add the remaining glutinous powder and press it well to make a dough.
Shape the glutinous mixture into egg-sized balls. Put all glutinous balls onto a tray.
Now flatten 1 glutinous ball using your hand and fill it with 1 tsp of sweetened red mongo, roll it again to wrap the filling.
Do the same procedure with the remaining balls.
Roll all balls onto the sesame seeds.
Heat oil in a pan, and cook all glutinous balls until golden brown.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Potato Croquettes Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix mashed potato, butter, milk, salt, ground black pepper, flour, and 1 pc egg. Mix well.
Prepare bread crumbs and beaten egg into a separate bowl.
Shape potato mixture into egg-sized rounds.
Dip each potato round into the egg then roll it onto the bread crumbs.
After all potato rounds are breaded already, heat oil in a skillet.
Cook all potato croquettes until golden brown.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Pichi-Pichi Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine grated cassava, water, sugar, lye water. Mix well.
Pour mixture into each mold.
Boil water into the steamer, and steam the cassava mixture for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, remove pichi-pichi from the steamer and let it cool.
Remove pichi-pichi from the molder and transfer onto a serving plate. Sprinkle with grated coconut.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Mami Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Miki (pour hot water onto the Miki noodles)
instructions: Fry half of the crushed garlic in a pan until golden brown. Set aside.
In a pot, saute the remaining garlic until golden brown, and then add the onion. Mix until softened.
Now add the beef brisket and beef bones into the pot, mix until brown.
Season it now with salt and ground black pepper, mix then pour all the water into the pot and add star anice. Cover and bring to boil.
When it is boiling already, lower the heat and boil it again for 1 1/2 hour.
After 1 1/2 hour, check if beef is already soft, if not, boil it for 30 minutes more or until beef softened.
Put Miki noodles into 4 bowls.
Transfer the beef meat into a flat surface or chopping board, and thinly slice it.
Put slices of beef meat in each bowl with Miki noodles. Add chopped young onion, a bit of fried garlic, sliced pechay baguio, and sliced boiled egg.
Ladle soup into each bowl. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Fresh Lumpia Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet, saute half of the crushed garlic until golden brown.
Add onion and saute until softened, and then add the ground pork and mix for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour in water and season with 1 tsp salt, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
If it's already boiling toss in the jicama (singkamas), cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, stir and add potatoes, carrots, and chayote. Cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, toss in the cabbage, Baguio beans, and sweet potato on top. Boil for 5 minutes.
When sweet potato turned yellowish already, pour the liquid into a bowl using a large strainer. Set aside the liquid and the lumpia mixture.
In a pot, combine shrimp stock, liquid sauce from the lumpia filling, salt, sugar, and cornstarch.
Cook over low heat until the sauce thickened.
Lay a piece of wrapper flat on a large plate. Put a lettuce leaf in the middle of the wrapper.
Now add 2 tbsp of lumpia mixture on top of the lettuce leaf.
Secure the filling by folding the lower part of the wrapper upwards.
Now pour the sauce on top of the fresh lumpia and sprinkle it with crushed peanut and crushed fried garlic.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Meatball Subs Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground beef and ground pork, and season it with parmessan cheese, mozzarella cheese, bread crumbs, egg, parsley, salt, ground black pepper, and garlic powder. Mix well.
Brush tray with oil. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Now make round meatball from the meat mixture about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Transfer the meatball onto a tray and make sure each meatball is at least 1 inch away from each other.
When you're done making the meatballs, bake it for 25 minutes.
Cook the sauce while waiting for the meatballs.
In a pan, saute onion, for 3 minutes, then add tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, ground black pepper, vinegar, garlic, and sugar. Stir over low heat for 5 minutes. Set aside.
When meatballs are cooked already remove it from the oven.
Slice footlong bread in half then arrange the meatballs in the bread and sprinkle it with cheese on top. Bake it again for 5 minutes to melt the cheese.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Paella Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Green pepper (medium and diced small)
instructions: In a pot, pour 5 cups of water and boil the chicken, season it with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp ground black pepper. Cook for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the chicken from the pot and set aside the chicken stock.
Shred the boiled chicken into not so small pieces.
In another pot, boil clams for 5 minutes or until clam shells opened. Set aside.
Put the shrimp in a pan, and season it with salt. Cover and cook for 10 minutes over medium-low heat without water.
After 10 minutes, add 1/2 tsp olive oil, and mix it for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, let it cool and shred the shrimp except for the tail. Set aside all the shrimp tails.
In a large skillet, saute garlic until golden brown then add onion, bell pepper. Mix for 5 minutes or until softened.
