Now add paprika, ground black pepper, tomatoes, and green peas. Mix then pour the chicken stock into the large skillet.
Bring to boil then add rice, season it with salt and saffron. Bring to boil and cover. Cook until rice grains are soft already.
Now add half of the clams and shredded shrimp. Mix well.
Transfer your dish into a large bowl then add the remaining clams and shrimp tails.
Sprinkle it with parsley on top. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Strawberry Cheesecake Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine crushed graham crackers, sugar, and butter. Mix well.
Layer the baking dish with baking paper then put the graham mixture into the baking dish evenly and press the graham mixture to compress.
Beat the egg in a bowl using the electric mixer, then add the cream cheese, vanilla, sour cream, and sugar. Mix it again for 5 minutes.
Preheat oven to 160 degrees F.
Then pour the cream cheese mixture into the graham mixture. Bake for 1 hour.
While waiting for the cream cheese prepare the sauce.
In a pan, put the whole strawberry, corn starch, sugar, vanilla, and salt. Stir over low heat until the mixture is smooth. Set aside.
After 1 hour, remove the cheesecake from the oven. Let it cool then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, pour the strawberry sauce on top of the cheesecake, and spread it evenly.
Get a slice, serve and enjoy!

title: Best Blackberry Pie Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup Water (Prepare extra water if needed)
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, butter, sugar, and water. Mix well to make a dough.
After making dough, cover the bowl and refrigerate.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
In another bowl, mix blackberries, sugar, and flour. Mix well.
Get the dough from the refrigerator.
Use the rolling pin to shape flatten the dough, then divide it into two.
Brush the baking dish with a bit of oil.
Flatten the dough using a rolling pin, and the size of it should fit on the baking dish.
Now arrange the dough into the baking dish, then pour the blackberry mixture into the dough.
Make the cover of your pie from the remaining dough, flatten it using the rolling pin then put it on top of the pie.
Bake it for 25 minutes. After 25 minutes, sprinkle it with a bit of sugar on top (optional).
Remove the baking dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, take a slice. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Buttermilk Pie Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, butter, sugar, and water. Mix well to make a dough.
After making the dough, cover the bowl, and put it inside the refregirator.
In a bowl, mix butter and sugar using an electric mixer for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add egg and flour. Mix it again then add the buttermilk and vanilla.
Brush the baking pan with a bit of oil, get the dough from the refrigerator and flatten it using a rolling pin.
Arrange the dough into the baking pan, then pour the filling into the prepared pie crust.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Bake it for 25 minutes or until top turned golden brown.
After 25 minutes, remove it from the oven, get a slice. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Puto Pao Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl, filter all-purpose flour using a strainer, then add baking powder, powdered milk, and sugar. Mix well and set aside.
In another bowl, combine egg, water, evaporated milk, and salt. Mix well.
After mixing the milk mixture, add the flour mixture. Mix until well-incorporated.
Boil water into the steamer, then pour puto mixture on each molder, just half of the height of the molder.
When you're done, place all the molder into the steamer and cover. Steam for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, transfer onto a plate. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Italian Meatballs Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup Italian sausage (cut into small cubes)
1 pc White onion (cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, combine powdered milk and bread crumbs. Set aside.

In another bowl, combine pork and beef meat then season it with salt, ground black pepper, Italian sausage, onion, garlic, parsley, and parmesan. Mix well then add the bread crumbs mixture into the pork and beef mixture. Mix well.
Form meat mixture into balls about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
When you're done making meatballs, heat oil in a pan and cook each meatball over low heat until browned.
After frying all the meatballs, pour the marinara sauce into the same pan and boil for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add all the fried meatballs into the pan with marinara sauce, cover, and cook for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, transfer into a bowl. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Turkey Meatballs Recipe
instructions: Put the ground turkey into a bowl then season it with breadcrumbs, onion, parsley, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, ground black pepper, and eggs. Mix until well incorporated.
After mixing all the ingredients, make round balls approximately 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
When you're done rounding all turkey mixture, heat olive oil in a pan, and cook the meatballs until golden brown.
Put all cooked meatballs onto a plate, and sprinkle it with onion on top.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Japanese Curry Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Pork meat (cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a pot, heat oil and saute onion until translucent.
Add pork then mix, and season it with salt, ground black pepper, and curry powder. Mix well then pour the chicken stock. Cook for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, add the carrot and potatoes.

Combine 1 cup of water and 1/4 cup corn starch to create a thick paste.  Pour the corn starch mixture into the pot. Stir the mixture slowly until boil. Cover the pot and cook for 15 minutes over low heat.
After 15 minutes, off the stove and serve in a bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Tuna Melt Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix tuna flakes, onion, salt, garlic, ground black pepper, sugar, hot sauce, and mayonnaise. Mix well.
Toast 8 pieces of bread in a pan or skillet.
Then scoop about 2 tablespoons of the tuna mixture on each of the bread and add 1 slice of cheese on each bread.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Korean Fried Chicken Recipe
instructions: Prepare beaten egg, put the flour in a bowl, and corn starch in a different bowl.
Season chicken breasts with salt and ground black pepper.
Coat the chicken first with flour, next dip chicken into the beaten egg, and lastly, roll chicken onto the corn starch.
Do the same procedure with the remaining chicken breast, and place it on a tray.
In a bowl, mix gochujang chili paste, brown sugar, and soy sauce. Mix until well incorporated.
Heat oil in a pan and fry chicken breasts until both sides turned golden brown.
After frying all chicken, mix the gochujang mixture onto the fried chicken in a bowl. Mix until chicken breasts are well coated.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Funnel Cake Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, put flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and beaten egg. Mix well.
Heat oil in a pan, then pour the funnel cake mixture into the funnel and cook it in a circular motion until both sides turned golden brown.
Transfer onto a plate and sprinkle with sugar powder. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: How To Cook The Best Sausage Recipe
instructions: Cook sausage in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add flour then mix for another 5 minutes.
Now pour the milk into the pan and season it with ground black pepper and salt. Mix until thickened.
Slice the bread buns into two to make top and bottom.
Place the buns onto a plate and pour 1 cup of the sausage gravy on it.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Fried Chicken Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, season chicken legs with 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp ground black pepper, calamansi juice, and seasoning. Cover the bowl and set aside for 30 minutes.
In another bowl, combine flour and corn starch. Add 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp ground black pepper.
Transfer the flour mixture onto a wide plate, and prepare the beaten eggs.

Heat oil in a pan, when the oil is hot already, first, roll the chicken leg onto the flour mixture and coat it well, then dip it into the beaten eggs, and lastly, roll it again onto the flour mixture. Do the same procedure with the remaining chicken legs.
Carefully put the chicken leg into the pan and cook it over low heat for 8-9 minutes each side or until golden brown.
Drain excess oil from the chicken using paper towels or by putting it in a strainer.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sweet Cornbread Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix well then set aside.
In another bowl, mix egg, sour cream, milk, and melted butter. Mix well.
After mixing the egg mixture, pour it into the flour mixture. Mix together to combine.
Brush the rectangular baking pan with butter then pour the cornbread mixture into the baking pan carefully.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Then bake the cornbread mixture for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, check the inner part of the cornbread using a toothpick. When the toothpick comes out clean it means the cornbread is cook already.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Pita Bread Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, put yeast then pour water into the bowl. Add 1 cup of flour and mix for 5 minutes.
After mixing for 5 minutes, add olive oil and salt. Mix well.
Now add another 2 cups of flour and knead for 10 minutes until dough softens. Cover in a large bowl then set aside for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, dust a clean surface with flour and turn the dough it out onto the surface.
Divide the dough into 8 pieces and roll into balls.
Now transfer it all into a tray and cover with plastic wrapper then set aside for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, roll each round for about 1/4-inch thick.
Heat a pan and brush it with a bit of oil and cook each side of the pita bread mixture for 3 minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Shish Kabob Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red onion (cut into big cubes)
1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into big cubes)
1 pc Green bell pepper (cut into big cubes)
instructions: In a large bowl, season beef with soy sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, seasoning, salt, ground black pepper, and onion powder. Marinade for 10 minutes.
Thread the beef meat, green and red bell pepper, red onion onto the barbecue sticks.
Do the same procedure with the remaining beef mixture.
Make fire with charcoals in a griller and make sure that the charcoals are glowing with less fire before you start grilling.
Grill the beef meat for 5 minutes each side.
Serve with your choice of sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Curry Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Carrot (medium and cut into big cubes)
1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into strips)
1 pc Green bell pepper (cut into strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic until golden brown, then add onion until translucent.
Add the beef into the pot and mix for 5 minutes, or until brown.
After 5 minutes, add curry powder, ground black pepper, and fish sauce. Mix then pour the coconut milk into the pan, and stir until boil.
When it's boiling already, cover the pot and cook for 1 - 1 /12 hour, or until beef is tender.
When beef is tender already, add water, potatoes, carrots. Boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add red and green bell pepper. Then cook for the last 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Embutido Recipe
ingredients: 5 pcs Hotdog (big and cut into 4 pieces each)
5 slices  Cheese (cut into 3 long pieces each.)
instructions: In a large bowl, season ground beef with salt, ground black pepper, carrots, onion, garlic, raisins, red bell pepper, and pickle relish. Mix well.
In another bowl, mix fresh eggs, evaporated milk, and bread crumbs. Mix well then add the ground pork mixture into the milk and egg mixture. Mix well.
Brush the aluminum foil with butter, and make sure it is wide enough to cover the pork mixture.
After brushing the aluminum foil with butter, place 3/4 cup meat mixture in the aluminum foil and flatten it.
Put in the sliced cheese and hotdog,
Roll the foil to form 7 inches long cylinder to lock the cheese and hotdog filling in the meat mixture.
Close both sides of the foil, and apply the same procedures with the remaining meat mixture.
Steam meat mixture in a steamer for 1 hour.
After 1 hour, let it cool then remove it from the foil and fry it in a pan.
Transfer onto a plate. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Shoyu Ramen Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Carrots (peeled and cut into big cubes)
1/2 cup Bamboo sprout (boiled for 5 minutes and drained)
instructions: In a bowl, mix soy sauce, dried sake, mirin, and dried kombu. Cover and set aside for 8 hours.
In a pot, mix pork meat, salt, ground black pepper, chicken neck and wings, Baguio leeks, carrots, garlic, ginger, bonito flakes, and water. Boil for 1 1/2 hour.
After 1 1/2 hour, remove the pork and chicken meat from the pot, and transfer into a bowl. Set aside.
Cook the ramen noodles based on the instruction printed on its pack.
When ramen noodles are cooked already, transfer into a bowl, then top it with sliced pork meat, bamboo sprout, half of the boiled egg, scallion, and chili oil.
Pour 4 cups of stock in a pot, bring to boil then add 1/4 cup of soy sauce mixture. Stir until boil.
Pour the stock into the bowl with ramen mixture. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Baked Fritata Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red Bell Pepper (cut into cubes)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, fry the bacon until lightly brown, then add the onion and mix again. Add the spinach then transfer it in a bowl. In the same bowl, add the bell pepper, tomato, then mix well and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees F.
Beat all eggs in a bowl, then pour the milk and season it with salt and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Place all the sliced potatoes in the rectangular baking pot, then pour the mixture and beaten egg mixture into the baking pot.
Top it with parmesan cheese, and bake it for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Pastrami Sandwich Recipe
instructions: Heat butter in a pan then fry the pastrami over low heat until lightly brown. Set aside
In the same pan, toast both sides of the 2 slices of bread.
Add the cheese on a slice of bread, then put the pastrami on the other slice of bread.
Place the slice of bread with cheese on the other slice of bread with pastrami. Transfer it on a plate, then slice it to two triangular pastrami sandwich.
Serve with parsley on the side and enjoy!

title: Best Aligot Recipe
instructions: Bring 5 cups of water to boil, then add the potatoes and 1/4 tsp salt; boil the potatoes for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, drain the boiled potatoes and let it cool for a while.
Transfer the potatoes into a mixer, then mix until crushed.
After crushing all the potatoes, transfer it into a pan, add the garlic, butter, heavy cream, mozzarella cheese, and ground black pepper. Mix well over low heat.
When the mixture is already thickened, transfer it into a bowl.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Brownie Brittle Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Brush the baking pan with butter and layer it with a baking sheet paper.
Mix the butter, sugar, and vanilla in a bowl until evenly mixed. Then add the egg and blend it well.
In a bowl, mix the flour, baking soda, and salt, then add this to the butter mixture. Mix until smoothened.
Pour the mixture into a baking pan, then bake it for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, sprinkle it with chocolate chips on top, then slice the brownie brittle and transfer on a plate.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Pork Ramen Recipe
instructions: In a pot, season the pork meat with soy sauce and mirin, then boil for 1 1/2 hour, or until tender over low heat.
After 1 1/2 hour, let it cool, then slice thinly and 3 inches wide.
In a pot, put the ginger and garlic, then pour the chicken and pork broth. Boil for 15 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the pack's instruction, then drain and divide into 4 bowls.
Add spinach leaves in each bowl, then fill each bowl with broth.
Slice each egg in the middle then add it on top.
Add the sliced pork equally in each bowl, then put the bean sprout, and sprinkle it with spring onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Thai Basil Eggplant Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into strips)
1 pc Green bell pepper (cut into strips)
1 pc Green chili pepper (cut into strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, saute the garlic until golden brown, then add the onion then mix until translucent. Add the ginger and mix for a couple of seconds.
Add the eggplant into the pan and season it with salt and ground black pepper. Mix and pour the water, then cover and cook for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the red bell pepper, green bell pepper, and green chili pepper. Mix then add the basil leaves.
Serve hot in a bowl and enjoy!

title: Best Eggplant Parmesan Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Eggplant (cut into rounds for 1/2 inch thick)
instructions: Sprinkle both sides of the sliced eggplants, then transfer it into a strainer to keep it dry.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
In a bowl, mix the eggs and milk. Blend well.
Dip the sliced eggplants into the egg mixture, then roll it on the bread crumbs.
Place the sliced eggplants into the baking pot and make the first layer, then add marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese on the 1st layer.
Place all the remaining sliced eggplants into the baking pot, then add the remaining marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, and oil on top.
Bake for 25 minutes. After 25 minutes, remove the baking pot from the oven. Sprinkle it with basil leaves.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sancocho Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc White onion (cut into small cubes)
1 pc Corn (fresh and cut into 2-inch long)
1 pc Cassava (big and cut into big cubes)
1 pc Taro (big and cut into big cubes)
instructions: Season beef and chicken with cumin, oregano, paprika, and garlic.
Heat oil in a large pot, then add the seasoned chicken and beef, mix and cover the pot.
Add water then bring it to boil for 15 minutes over low heat, and stir it occasionally.
After 15 minutes, add onion, stir for 5 minutes, then add yucca, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix and pour the chicken broth and boil for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, remove the chicken and set aside. Boil the beef for another hour.
After an hour, add the chicken again into the pot, then add sausage.
Boil for another 5 minutes, then add corn, taro, cassava, and Chinese parsley.
After 5 minutes, add squash and pour a bit more water. Boil for 10 minutes.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!

title: Best Pork Pie Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 kg Pork meat (chopped into small cubes)
instructions: Melt lard with water in a saucepan, then put the flour in a bowl, once lard is melted already pour it into the bowl. Mix until smooth and set aside.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
In a bowl, mix ground pork, pork cubes, and bacon, then season it with mace, nutmeg, sage, thyme, salt, and white pepper. Mix well.
Divide dough into 4, then use a rolling pin to make flat and thin round doughs.
Mold the pastry to layer the round baking pan, then add filling at the center (don't fill it fully).
Beat the eggs then brush the top of the pastry.
Make another flat round doughs to cover your pastry,
Use a fork to push the sides of the pie, then put a hole on the top of the pastry. Brush the top of the pastry with the beaten eggs again.
Bake for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, mix the gelatin powder with 1 cup water, mix until powder is dissolved.
Pour the gelatin mixture into each hole of the pastry, then bake it again for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Roasted Pork Loin
ingredients: 1/2 cup Thyme (fresh and chopped into small pieces)
instructions: Slightly cut some parts of the pork meat near its skin then seasoned it with olive oil, salt. Then fill the pork cuts with crushed garlic and fresh chopped thyme.
Put it in a bowl and cover it. Place it in the refrigerator and wait for one day.

Preheat the oven to 250 degrees F. Then Bake the marinated pork for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes check the pork cuts and lower the heat of the oven down to 200 degrees F. Continue baking the pork for another 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the oven.
Thinly slice the pork.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Cheese Ball Recipe
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kinchay leaves (cut into small pieces )
instructions: Put the grated cheese in a bowl, then season it with ground black pepper, dried herbs, chili flakes, garlic powder, and kinchay leaves. Mix well.
Peel and grate the potatoes in a bowl then add salt. Mash the grated potatoes well.
Prepare the beaten egg, corn starch, and bread crumbs.
Get 3 tbsp of mashed potato, and make a small ball from this mixture.
Flatten the ball then add cheese mixture at the center. Now bring the ball together.
Do the same procedure for the remaining ingredients.
Once you're done making the cheese balls, roll them in corn starch. Next, dip each of the cheese balls in the beaten egg. Lastly, roll them in bread crumbs.
Deep fry the cheese balls until golden brown over low heat.
Serve with ketchup and enjoy!

title: Best Chilean Sea Bass
instructions: Mix 1 tsp dill, butter, lemon juice, shallot, garlic, and wine. Boil for 10 minutes over low heat.
Season the Chilean sea bass fillet with salt and ground black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan and fry the Chilean sea bass until golden brown.
After frying, put it on a plate then pour the sauce on the Chilean sea bass and sprinkle it with dill.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Gyoza Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ground beef, cabbage, scallion, garlic, soy sauce, salt, pepper, and ginger. Mix well.
Get 1 gyoza wrapper, then put 1 1/2 tsp of the ground beef mixture.
Fold the wrapper in half, then seal it with moistened fingers. Apply the same procedure with the remaining gyoza wrapper.
Heat oil in a pan. Cook each side of gyoza for 1 minute, or until lightly brown.
Pour the water and bring it to boil for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, pour the remaining sesame oil, then boil for another 3 minutes or until the water is gone.
Serve it on a plate with the sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Wonton Soup Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs White Onion (cut into small cubes)
1/2 pc Ginger (thumb and crushed into small pieces)
1 pc Ginger (thumb and cut into cubes)
instructions: Put the ground pork in a bowl, then season it with soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, salt, pepper, and cornstarch. Mix well.
Get wonton wrapper and fill it with 1 tbsp of ground pork mixture. Wet the edges of the wonton wrapper, then fold it diagonally to create a triangle.
Do the same procedure with the remaining wonton wrapper.
Heat olive oil in a pot, and saute the onion, then add the garlic and ginger. Saute for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour the chicken broth into the pot, then bring to boil.
Add the wontons and boil for 10 minutes.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Calzone Recipe
ingredients: 6 pcs Baby spinach leaves (cut into small strips)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan. Then add the mushroom and saute for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add garlic powder, dried basil, 1/2 cup pizza sauce, 2 cups shredded mozarella cheese, parmesan cheese, and baby spinach leaves. Continue mixing for 5 minutes then set aside.
Put the flour in a bowl, then add the baking powder, butter, and water. Mix this until smooth, then set aside and let it rise for 20 minutes.
Preheat over to 500 degrees F for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 round pieces.
On a lightly floured surface, roll one round dough for about 1/4" thick flat round dough.
Then add filling in the middle of the dough. To the same procedure for the remaining ingredients.
Gently fold the dough into half; pinch together then crimp edges all around. Do the same procedure with the remaining dough.
Transfer to a baking tray. Crack the egg in a bowl and add 1 tsp water, then beat it.
Brush the tops of calzone with beaten egg, then bake for 10-15 minutes.
Serve with pizza sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Taco Salad Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs White onion (cut into small cubes)
1/4 kg Lettuce (fresh and cut into shreds)
instructions: Heat butter in a pan. Then saute the onion for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add the ground beef and mix until it turned brown.
Season the ground beef with salt, ground black pepper, oregano powder, taco powder, chili powder, tomato sauce, and cooked corn grains. Cook for another 5 minutes then set aside.
In a large bowl, mix the lettuce with tomatoes, sugar, cheese, salad dressing, and ground beef. Mix well.
Serve with tortillas, and enjoy!

title: Best Squash Casserole Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Squash (peeled and cut into big cubes)
2 pcs White Onion (big and cut into cubes)
instructions: Boil the squash for 10 minutes in a pot, then drain and dry using paper towels.
Put the boiled squash in the baking dish.
Melt 4 tbsp of butter in a pan, then saute the onion over low heat until softened.
Put the sauteed onion on top of the boiled squash, then layer it with cheese, beaten egg, sugar, salt, mayonnaise, and butter crackers.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Bake the squash mixture for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, remove the baking dish from the oven.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Shrimp Alfredo Recipe
instructions: Season the peeled shrimp with salt, ground black pepper in a bowl.
Heat butter in a pan, cook the shrimp until pink, then set aside.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat, then saute the garlic until golden brown. Then add the heavy cream and stir for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, add the parmesan cheese, salt, nutmeg, ground black pepper, and water. Stir until thickened.
Add the pasta, then mix until the sauce blended with the pasta.
Transfer it to a large plate, then top it with shrimp and sprinkle it with parmesan cheese and parsley.
Serve hot, and enjoy!

title: Best Corn Pudding Recipe
instructions: Brush the baking pan with butter, then preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
In a large bowl, lightly beat the eggs, then add the melted butter, sugar. Mix well.
Pour the milk into the bowl, then add the cornstarch, nutmeg, and vanilla. Mix well.
Lastly, add the corn and blend it well with the ingredients. Transfer it to the baking pan and bake it for 50 mins and turn the baking pan occasionally to make sure it's evenly baked.
The corn pudding is already cooked if the top turned brown already.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Braciole Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Beef meat (thinly sliced and 2 inches wide)
instructions: In a bowl, put 4 pcs of sliced garlic, parsley, cheese, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Get 1 slice of beef and top it with prosciutto and ingredients mixture. Then roll it and use a toothpick to lock the rolled beef.
Do the same procedure with the remaining sliced beef.

Heat olive oil in a pan, then fry the rolled beef until brown. After cooking all the rolled beef, put it all again in the pan and add the wine, beef broth, crushed tomato, and the remaining seasoning in the bowl.
Cook it for 1 1/2 hour over low heat. After 1 1/2 hour, remove the toothpick from the rolled beef.
Sprinkle it with parsley. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Souffle Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, separate the egg yolk from the egg white.
Brush the ramekin with butter and sprinkle it with sugar. Set aside.
Mix the egg yolk with sugar using the manual hand mixer until the sugar is melted.
In a pan, melt the butter and add it to the egg yolk mixture. Then mix it for 15 minutes.
After 15 minutes, add the flour, and mix it for another 10 minutes, or until the texture is fluffy. Set aside.
Mix the egg white using the electric hand mixer for 20 minutes, or until the texture is fluffy.
Mix the souffle mixture to the egg white. Mix the souffle mixture and egg white in one direction only.
Carefully pour the mixture into the ramekin.
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees F.
Bake it for 10 minutes, or until the layer turned golden brown.
Sprinkle it with sugar powder. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Cracker Barrel Meatloaf Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc White Onion (big and cut into small cubes)
1/4 cup Bell pepper (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

Put the ground beef in a bowl and season it with crackers, eggs, white onion, bell pepper, cheese, oregano powder, thyme powder, garlic powder, fresh parsley, milk, salt, Worcestershire sauce, and ground black pepper. Mix well.
After mixing all the ingredients, layer the loaf pan with foil and turn out the loaf mixture onto the pan. Shape into a loaf, then bake for 30 minutes.
For the topping, mix the ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, and apple cider vinegar. Mix well.
Spread the topping on top of the meatloaf.
Bake it again for 20 minutes, or until topping turned golden brown.
After 20 minutes, remove the loaf pan from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the meat. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Takoyaki Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 cup Pickled red ginger (cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Add the egg, soy sauce, pickled red ginger, and cold water. Mix well.
Brush the takoyaki plate with oil. Then fill each hole with the mixture and add 4 pcs of bite-size octopus each whole.
You can cook your takoyaki in the oven. Preheat the oven to 250 degrees F.
Cook the takoyaki mixture for 5 minutes, then carefully flip each takoyaki and cook it for another 5 minutes, or until golden brown.
When all takoyaki are cooked already, put it on a large plate and sprinkle it with cabbage, dried bonito, dried seaweed, and mayonnaise.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Crumpets Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix milk, water, and yeast. Mix well and set aside for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add salt and stir and slowly add the flour. After mixing well, set aside for another 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, heat a flat pan and put the rings on it.
Pour crumpet mixture in each ring and cook for 10 minutes over low heat. After 10 minutes, flip and cook the other side of the crumpet for 5 minutes until light brown.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Creamy Pasta Salad Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Green pepper (cut into small cubes)
1 pc Red pepper (cut into small cubes)
1/2 cup White onion (cut into small cubes)
1/4 cup Green olive (cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a large bowl, mix boiled elbow macaroni, cucumber, onion, red and green bell pepper, boiled kidney beans, sweet corn, green olive, salt, ground black pepper, and sugar. Mix well.
Then add mayonnaise, yogurt, and nestle cream. Mix well then cover the bowl.
Refrigerate for  20 minutes.
Serve cold and enjoy!

title: Best Beef Ramen Recipe
ingredients: 3 cloves Garlic (1 clove is crushed and minced the other 2 is crushed only)
1 tsp Spring onion (cut into small pieces)
instructions: In a pot, boil beef bones with 1 crushed garlic, and slightly crushed ginger.
Boil for 6 hours.
Season the beef loin with salt.
Boil eggs for 6 minutes. After 6 minutes, mix soy sauce, 1/2 tbsp sugar, and 1 crushed garlic.
Peel the eggs, then put it on the soy sauce mixture. Mix well.

In a pot, boil ramen noodles for 8 minutes. After 8 minutes, transfer the noodles into a bowl and add pieces of uncooked beef loin, garlic, and 1 boiled egg sliced into two, sprinkle with spring onion.
Use a strainer to pour 3 cups of beef broth into a pot, then add 1/2 tsp mirin, 1/2 tsp miso, and 1/2 tbsp sugar.  Bring to boil, then pour it into the bowl with beef ramen.
Serve hot and enjoy.

title: Best Yakitori Recipe
instructions: In a pot, mix soy sauce, mirin sauce, water, sugar, and 6 pcs scallion leaves. Boil for 20 minutes, or until 1/2 cup of the mixture is left.
Slice the scallion for about 2-inch pieces, then cut chicken breast into 1-inch cubes.
Fold each slice of chicken, then insert the stick into the chicken in 45 degrees angle, and press down on the skewer to pierce through the center. Alternate chicken slice with a piece of scallion.
Do the same procedure with the remaining ingredients.
Transfer it all into a baking dish, then brush with sauce mixture each meat.
Preheat oven to 200 degrees F.
Occasionally,  brush the chicken meat with sauce mixture and make sure to cook it evenly.
After 20 minutes, transfer your yakitori onto a plate.
Serve with your choice of sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Ravioli Recipe
ingredients: 1 bunch Spinach  (fresh and cut into small pieces)
instructions: In a bowl, put 3 cups of flour, eggs, 1 tsp of salt, olive oil, and water. Mix this until smooth, then set aside.
Mix the cream cheese, mozzarella cheese, salt, and ground black pepper in a bowl.
Boil the spinach for 5 minutes, then drain and squeeze the spinach.
Add the boiled spinach in the cheese mixture, then mix well and set aside.
Divide the dough into 4, then flatten it using the rolling pin for about 3 inches square size.
Place 1  teaspoon of filling in apart over of pasta sheet. Rub with beaten egg around filling to moisten, and cover it with another pasta sheet.
Press the edges of pasta sheets using a fork to lock it. Do the same procedure with the remaining pasta sheets.
Bring water to boil in a pot, then add salt. Add the ravioli and boil it for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, drain the ravioli and transfer it on a plate, then pour the marinara sauce on top of the ravioli.
Sprinkle it with parmesan cheese. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Salmon Steak Recipe
instructions: Season both sides of salmon with salt, ground black pepper, and garlic powder.
In a wide pan, melt the butter and saute garlic over low heat, then spread the garlic and add the salmon.
Cook the salmon until lightly brown. When both sides of salmon are already light brown transfer on a plate and sprinkle with Chinese parsley on top.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Broccoli Slaw Recipe
instructions: Wash the broccoli slaw with warm water, then drain. Transfer to a bowl, then add the onion, mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, sugar, lime juice, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate it for 15 minutes.
Top it with fresh parsley. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Egg Foo Young Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup Carrot (cut into cubes and steamed)
1/2 cup Green bell pepper (chopped into small cubes)
1 pc White Onion (Medium and cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a large bowl, beat all eggs. Then add the chopped onion, steamed carrot, green peas, chopped bell pepper. bean sprout, soy sauce, ground black pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Heat the olive oil in a medium-sized pan over medium heat then add half of the egg mixture. Flatten the top like a pancake.
Cook the egg mixture until set and brown. It should take 3 minutes. Then flip and cook the other side for 2 minutes more.
Remove it and set aside on a plate lined up with paper towels.
When all the egg mixtures are cooked, mix the chicken stock, soy sauce, dry sherry, and corn starch in a pan. Stir well over low heat and bring to boil to thicken. Remove from heat.
Serve the egg foo young with the sauce and enjoy!

title: Best Philly Cheesesteak Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Beef loin (thinly sliced for about 1 1/2 inch)
1 pc Red onion  (big and thinly sliced)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan.
Season the sliced beef loin with salt and ground black pepper. Then put it in the pan and fry it over low heat.
Cook the beef loin for 7-10 minutes and make sure that both sides are evenly cooked.
In a casserole, heat the olive oil. Then add the green chili, onion, and cayenne pepper. Saute the ingredients over low heat. Add the mushroom button and garlic, and saute for another 5 minutes.
When each side of the beef loin turned brown already, place the cheese on the top of the beef loin. Cover the pan and let the cheese melt for 5 minutes.
When the cheese melted already, remove it and put it on a wide plate. Then side it with the sauteed ingredients from the casserole.
Serve with hoagie rolls or your choice of bread.

title: Best Hash Brown Casserole Recipe
instructions: In a bowl,  mix the cream of chicken, sour cream, and egg. Mix well,
Add the hash brown, onion, and 1 cup of cheddar cheese. Stir until well combined.
Add the ground black pepper then mix well.
Prepare the baking dish and make sure that it's dry. Rub the baking dish with butter then, add the hash brown mixture. Make sure that it is evenly spread in the baking dish.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Then top the hash brown mixture with the remaining 1 cup of cheddar cheese. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 mins or until it turned brown.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Pozole Rojo Recipe
instructions: In a pan, fry the pork until turned light brown. Then set a side.
Saute the onion first and add the garlic. Then pour the chicken broth, add the hominy, salt, laurel leaves, cumin, dried oregano, ground black pepper, and chili powder. Mix well.
Boil the mixture for 1 hour. After 1 hour, add additional 2 cups of water then boil for another 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, remove the pork from the pot then cut it into shreds. Bring the shredded pork back in the pot then boil for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, serve it in a large bowl and top it with onion and parsley.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Taco Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Chicken breast (cut into small cubes)
1/2 cup Cilantro leaves (cut into small pieces)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Put the chicken breast and cook until it turned brown. Then season the chicken breast with chili powder, cumin, paprika, dried oregano, garlic powder, and salt.
Mix well for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, set aside.

Prepare the cilantro leaves, tomatoes, avocado, shredded cheese, and the chicken. Get 1 tortilla then fold it and fill it with 1 tbsp chicken, 1 tsp tomato, 1 tsp avocado, 1 tsp cilantro leaves, and top it with shredded cheese and lime.
Do the same procedure  the remaining ingredients.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Cube Steak Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine the beef meat, salt, ground black pepper, and steak seasoning. Mix well then set aside.
Mix the flour, paprika, salt and ground black pepper in a wide plate. Mix well.
Coat the beef meat using the flour mixture.
Melt the butter in a heated pan.
Place the coated beef meat carefully in a low heated pan. Cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes  on each side.
When all steaks have been fried off, saute the minced onion in the same pan until it turns translucent. Finally, put the fried steak on the sauteed onion.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Coconut Chicken Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Chicken  (boneless and cut into bite-size)
1 pc Onion (big and cut into small cubes)
instructions: In a pan, saute onion and add paprika and chili flake, saute for 3 minutes, then add chicken, mix, and season with salt and ground black pepper. Mix for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, add coconut milk then bring to boil. Cover the pan and cook for 20 minutes over low heat and stir occasionally.
After 20 minutes, serve hot with onion rings on top and enjoy!

title: Best Mexican Casserole Recipe
instructions: In a large pan, cook ground beef with onion until brown, then add jalapeño, diced tomato, corn, black beans, and taco seasoning, mix again for 10 minutes. Set aside
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Brush the baking dish with a bit of oil, and add four tortillas to make the first layer. Then add half of the beef mixture into the baking dish and spread sour cream on the top of the beef mixture.
Add the remaining tortillas, and pour the remaining beef mixture, cover the baking dish with aluminum foil, then bake it for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, remove the baking dish from the oven and add parmesan cheese on the top, then bake it for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Malai Kofta Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix grated potato, white cheese, 2 tbsp cashew, green chili, Chineses celery, 1/4 tsp cumin, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Add the flour, then mix well. Shape the potato mixture into balls.
Heat oil in a pan, and fry the potato mixture balls until brown.
For the sauce, saute onion in a pot for 5 minutes using the butter, after 5 minutes, add tomato, garlic, then mix again.
After mixing, season it with cardamom, laurel leaves, cinnamon, chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, masala, and water. Stir for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, let it cool, then transfer it into a blender, blend the sauce mixture for 3 minutes. The heat it again for 5 minutes on the stove until thickened.
Transfer all the fried potato balls on a plate, then pour the sauce over the potato balls, and top with sour cream.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Sauerbraten Recipe
ingredients: 1 kg Beef tenderloin (sliced into 3 inches long and 1-inch thick)
2 pcs White onion (large and cut into chunks)
10 pcs Thyme (fresh and cut into 1 inch)
2 pcs Carrots (medium and cut into 1-inch chunks)
instructions: In a pot, pour the 2 cups beef broth, then add the wine, vinegar, onion, garlic, thyme, laurel leaves, juniper berries, and whole black pepper. Boil for 5 minutes over low heat.
After 5 minutes, pour the boiled seasoning in a resealable bag with the sliced beef tenderloin.
Refrigerate the seasoned beef for 3 days.
After 3 days, preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Put the olive oil in the baking pot, then add the beef tenderloin and the seasoning.
Bake until all sides turned brown. Set aside.
In the same baking pot, put salt, carrot, celery, ginger, ground black pepper, sour cream. Stir for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, sprinkle it with flour, then mix it well.
Pour the beef broth into the pot. Bring to boil, then add the beef and bring it to boil.
Transfer the pot back in the oven and cook the beef for another 2 hours and 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, transfer the sauerbraten on a large plate.
Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Best Stuffed Burger Patties Recipe
instructions: Combine ground pork, ground beef, parsley, garlic powder, salt. and ground black pepper in a large bowl. Mix well.
Scoop around 1/4 cup mixture from the bowl and roll it into a ball shaped figure using your hands.

Put it in a middle of a burger stuffer tool. Press. Arrange a decent amount of bell peppers and cheese in the middle. Top with 2 to 3 tablespoons of meat mixture to secure the opening. Perform this step until all ingredients are consumed.
Heat-up the grill or grilling pan. Start to grill the first side for 3-5 minutes. Turn it over and continue to grill the other side for 5-7 minutes.
Arrange in a plate. Serve as it is or place it in between two buns.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Stir Fried Pepper Steak Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Small green bell pepper (cut into 1/2 inch strips)
1 pc Small red bell pepper (cut into 1/2 inch strips)
1 pc Small yellow bell pepper (cut into 1/2 inch strips)
instructions: In a bowl, marinate beef with oyster sauce, seasoning, pepper and cornstarch. Mix well and set aside.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a pan.
Stir-fry the bell peppers for 3-5 minutes.
Remove the bell peppers and set aside.
Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of oil in the same cooking pot. Add the marinated beef. Stir fry for 8 minutes or until the beef is completely cooked.
Add the bell peppers back and then stir-in the scallions. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve over rice.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Teriyaki Bistek Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine beef with soy sauce, sugar, salt and pepper. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat the cooking oil and then sear the marinated beef for 5 minutes.
Pour-in the remaining marinade, water, and sesame oil. Stir and then let boil. Simmer for 20 minutes Add water as necessary.
Let the liquid reduce to half. Pour-in cornstarch diluted in water. Stir until the sauce thickens.
Add the onion. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
Serve. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Papis Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan.
Saute garlic until brown. Then add the onion and cook until it turns transparent.
Add the beef and season with salt and pepper.
Pour-in beef stock then cover and boil for 1 hour over low heat.
Once the beef gets tender, add the pork and beans and cook for another 5 minutes.
Transfer in a serving plate. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Adobong Puti Recipe
instructions: Arrange chicken in a large bowl. Add chicken stock, bay leaf, pepper, and vinegar. Mix well. Marinate for at least 30 minutes. Note: Keep the marinade sauce for later use.
Heat oil in a pan. Fry each chicken piece for 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from the pan, and then place on a clean plate. Set aside.
Using the remaining oil, saute garlic for 20 seconds. Add the pan-fried chicken. Pour the remaining marinade ingredients and add water and sugar. Let boil.
Cover the pan and adjust heat between low and medium. Cook for 25 minutes. Add more water if needed.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with warm rice. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Braised Beef Recipe
instructions: Heat a cooking pot and pour-in olive oil.
Sauté onion until soft and add dried thyme then put-in beef and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Then, pour-in wine and beef stock. Cover and let it boil for 1 1/2 hour over low to medium heat. Note: Wait until the beef gets tender. Add water if needed.
Add the carrots and celery then cook until the vegetables are tender.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Tofu Sarciado Recipe
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Then fry the tofu until brown. Set aside.
In another pan, sauté the garlic, tomato, and onion until then onion become soft.
Add water and fish sauce. Stir and let boil.
Add the beaten egg. Quickly stir and then cook for 2 minutes while gradually stirring.
Add the fried tofu. Sprinkle with ground black pepper. Stir and cook for a minute more.
Transfer to a serving plate. Top with dried parsley.
Serve. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Crab Rangoon Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, mix the crabmeat, cream cheese, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and ground black pepper. Mix well.
Prepare the wonton wrapper and beaten egg. Get 1 wonton wrapper and add 2 teaspoons of filling to the middle of the wonton.

Wet the edges of the wrapper by dipping your finger in the beaten egg. Carefully bring up the 4 edges of the wrapper, so they'll all meet in the middle. Make sure that it is completely closed. The output should be a four-sided triangle with a bottom.
Heat the oil in a pan over low heat. Then deep fry the dumplings until it turns golden brown.
Put all the crab rangoon on a clean plate and side it with finely chopped green onions.
Serve with sauce of your choice.

title: Best Lengua Estofado Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs Beef lengua (boiled until tender and sliced)
1 pc White onion (big size, finely chopped)
instructions: Heat oil in a wide cooking pot
Dredge the slice lengua in flour (shake away the excess flour) and then pan-fry in medium heat for 1 minute per side. Set aside.
Add onion and garlic on the pot. Continue to cook until the onion gets tender.
Pour the can of diced tomato and wine. Stir.
Add the pan fried beef lengua.
Stir-in soy sauce and water. Let boil.
Add the bay leaves. Cover and cook in low heat until the sauce reduces to half.
Add the vinegar. Allow the sauce to re-boil.
Add sugar, green olives, black olives, and mushrooms. Stir. Cook for 5 to 8 minutes.
Sprinkle some salt and ground black pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve.

title: Best Beef Empanada Recipe
instructions: Make the filing by heating 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan.
Saute the onion and then add the ground black pepper.
Put-in the beef and then cook for 5 minutes.
Add the raisins, paprika, sugar, and salt. Stir and then pour-in the beef broth.
Cover and then simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove the cover and let the liquid evaporate.
Add the green peas.Stir and then cook for 2 minutes
Turn-off the heat. Set aside.
Prepare the dough by placing the salt, flour, baking powder, and sugar in a mixing bowl. Use a wire whisk to mix the ingredients.

Put the butter pieces in the mixing bowl along with the cold water. Mix using a pastry blender. If you don't have one, use 2 kitchen knives instead. You should mix like you are cutting the dough in several pieces.
Scoop about 3 tablespoons of the mixture and then shape it into a ball. Do this until all the dough is consumed.
Refrigerate the dough balls for about 20 to 25 minutes.

Flatten the dough ball by gently pressing the center with your hand against a clean flour-dusted flat surface. Use a rolling pin to spread the dough and make a flat circle about 4 to 5 inches in diameter.
Arrange about 4 to 5 tablespoons of filling in the middle of the dough. Lock the edges by folding or by pressing the tip of a fork in both sides.
Meanwhile, heat about 2 to 3 cups of oil in a cooking pot. Deep fry the empanadas for about 3 to 5 minutes or until the color turns golden brown.
Remove from the cooking pot and then arrange in a plate lined with paper towels. Let the excess oil drip-off.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Scotch Egg Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, put pork and season with salt and pepper.
Add sugar, garlic powder, sherry and flour.
Then pour-in Worcestershire sauce. Mix well.
Scoop 2-3 tablespoon of the pork mixture and form a ball. Then flatten it into an oval-shaped pattie.
Then wrap the boiled egg with the pork mixture pattie.
Dip into the beaten egg, followed by the breadcrumbs. Roll in the egg and breadcrumbs again for a really good coating. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a deep pan or deep fat fryer.
Fry the wrapped egg until it turns golden brown.
Then remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper.
Cool the Scotch eggs slightly, then arrange on a plate.

title: Best Crab Salad Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl, combine crabmeat with celery, onion and fresh dill.
Then pour-in seasoning and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper. Then mix well.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove from the refrigerator.
Serve, share and enjoy! Note: You can add the remaining fresh dill on top (optional)

title: Best Easy Kung Pao Shrimp Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into 1 inch long)
1 pc Green bell pepper (cut into 1 inch long)
instructions: Heat a pan or wok then pour the cooking oil.
Once the cooking oil gets hot, saute onion for 5 minutes.
Add the green and red bell pepper. Continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Then season with salt and pepper.
Add-in the garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Put the shrimps and cook for 5 minutes or until it turns lightly pink in color. Note: Do not overcook.
Then add the chili and peanuts, cook for 5 minutes. Set aside.
In another pan, combine the ingredients of the sauce. Soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch and water. Stir and cook for 2-3 minutes over low heat or until it boils.
Then gradually pour-in the sauce in the shrimp.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Cioppino Recipe
instructions: Heat butter in a casserole.
Cook the onions for 3 minutes. Then add-in garlic and parsley, continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Then add the tomato flakes and cook until it melted.
Pour-in chicken stock, then add the clams and mussels. Let it boil for 5-7 minutes.
Then put the bay leaf, basil, thyme, oregano and wine. Let it boil for another 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add the shrimp, scallops, fillet, crabmeat. Then pour-in water.
Bring it to boil for 30 minutes.
Then transfer in a bowl. Eat while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Breaded Shrimp with Sweet and Sour Sauce Recipe
instructions: Put shrimps in a bowl.
Sprinkle salt and pepper on the shrimp and mix well. Let it stand for 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a deep pan.
Dredge the shrimp in flour and then dip in the beaten egg. Quickly roll the shrimp over the breadcrumbs. Make sure that the shrimp are well coated.
Deep fry for 3-5 minutes or until the color turns golden brown.
Arrange in a plate lined with paper towels. This will absorb the oil.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with Sweet and Sour Sauce.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Adobong Labong Recipe
ingredients: 2 cups Bamboo shoot (cut into strips, 1 to 2 inch length)
instructions: Pour cooking oil in a pan then apply heat.
Sauté garlic and onions for 2-3 minutes.
Add pork then cook for 3 minutes.
Pour-in pork broth and let boil. Cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add shrimps, bamboo shoots, salt, and ground black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour-in vinegar and let boil. Simmer uncovered for 3 to 5 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate then serve.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Sinanglay na Tilapia Recipe
ingredients: 4 pcs Tilapia (large, cleaned and scales removed)
instructions: In a bowl, combine garlic, onion, tomatoes, and ginger then season with salt and mix.
Stuff the tilapia with the mixture.
Wrap the bok choy around the tilapia. Use 2 bok choy leaves to ensure that the entire fish is wrapped.
Arrange the wrapped tilapia in a wide cooking pan then pour-in coconut milk and water. Cover, and turn on heat.
Cook the fish in medium heat for 15 minutes.
Turn off heat. Remove the cooking twine and transfer the fish to a serving plate.
Serve hot. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Fish Lumpia Recipe
instructions: In large bowl, mix shredded Bangus with celery, onion, carrot, parsley and singkamas.
Season with salt and pepper. Then mix well.

Scoop 1 to 2 tablespoons of the fish mixture and arrange on the lower part of the wrapper. Mold using your hands to form a long cylinder and partially press to compress the mixture. Secure the filling by folding both sides of the wrapper inwards until the mixture is covered.
Roll the wrapper starting from the bottom to the top. Dip your finger in egg and rub it over the tip of the wrapper to make it sticky. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil gets hot enough, start to fry the fish lumpia for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown. Turn over to cook the other side.
Transfer to a cooling rack. Let the oil drip.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce. Enjoy!

title: Best Crispy Tilapia Sticks Recipe
instructions: Combine the salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and ground black pepper in a bowl mix well.
Rub the mixture all over the sliced tilapia fillets.
Meanwhile, pour the oil in a deep cooking pot. Turn-on the heat and start to heat-up the oil.
Dip the tilapia fillet in the bowl with beaten egg then dredge the tilapia in breadcrumbs. Note: Make sure that the tilapia is well coated.
Then, put the breaded tilapia into the hot oil and start to deep fry the fish until the color turns golden brown. Use medium heat in this step.
Remove the deep fried crispy tilapia sticks from the cooking pan and place in a plate lined with paper towel.This will absorb the excess oil.
Transfer the crispy tilapia sticks in a serving plate.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Odong Recipe
ingredients: 3 cans Spicy Sardines in tomato sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a casserole.
Once hot, saute garlic until golden brown. Then add the onion and cook until it gets soft.
Add-in the bottle gourd and then, add the sardines.
Season with salt and pepper. Let it boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, pour-in water and boil for another 5 minutes while covered.
Then, add the odong noodles and cook for about 10 minutes.
Transfer in a serving plate.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Beer Battered Fish Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs Fillet fish (cut into 3 inch long, 2 inch thick)
instructions: Wash the fish and let it dry.
Once dried, season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

In a bowl, combine flour, salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder and egg. Mix well and then gradually pour 1 1/2 cup of beer while continuously mixing. Set aside.Note: Add the remaining beer until you get the desired thickness of the mixture.
Heat oil in a pan. Once hot, dredge the fish on the flour and dip on the beer mixture. Then fry until golden brown each side.
Transfer in a plate. Enjoy eating!

title: Best Galbi Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb Beef tenderloin (sliced into 6 inch long, 1/2 inch thick)
instructions: Make the marinade by combining soy sauce, garlic, sugars, wine, sesame oil, and chili powder in a bowl. Stir.
Place the sliced beef in a heavy duty freezer bag and pour in the marinade.
Secure the freezer bag by sealing the edges. Make sure to release all the air inside the bag before closing.
Place the bag in the fridge and marinate overnight.
Grill the short ribs for about 8-10 minutes per side (depending on the heat) while basting with the remaining marinade.
Place in a serving plate. Serve.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Pineapple Pork Stir Fry Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (sliced into strips)
2 pcs Baguio leak (cut into small pieces)
instructions: Separate the juice from the pineapple chunks. Set the chunks aside.
Heat oil in a pan.
When the oil becomes hot, add-in the ginger and then cook for 10 seconds.
Add the garlic and onion. Cook until the onion becomes soft.
Drain excess liquid from the marinated pork, and then put the pork in the wok. Stir fry for 3 minutes or until the color of the pork becomes light to medium brown.
Once the pork turns brown, season with salt and pepper.
Then pour-in oyster sauce, soy sauce, and pineapple juice. Stir well and cook for another 5 minutes over low heat.
Add the carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add-in pineapple chunks, broccoli and baguio leak. Simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Kung Pao Chicken Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs Chicken breast (boneless, cut into cubes)
instructions: In a bowl, combine chicken with wine, soy sauce and diluted cornstarch. Mix well. Then cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Prepare the sauce by mixing chili paste, vinegar and sugar together in a pan. Cook over low heat.
Then add the onion, chestnuts and peanuts. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Set aside.
Meanwhile, remove the chicken from the refrigerator and saute in a large skillet until the meat is white and juices run clear.
Then transfer the chicken in the pan with the cooked sauce. Let it boil for 5 minutes.
Transfer in a serving plate. Enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Marsala Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs Chicken breast (skinless, cut into 1/2 inch)
instructions: Combine flour, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix well.
Dredge the chicken in the flour mixture. Set aside.
Meanwhile, heat a pan and pour in olive oil and butter.
Once the oil is hot, put-in the chicken and pan fry each side in medium heat for about 3 minutes.
Remove the chicken and place in a plate.
Put-in the mushrooms, parsley, and Marsala wine. Bring the liquid to a boil and simmer for a minute.
Put-in the pan fried breasts and cook for a good 8 to 12 minutes (covered).
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve with steamed rice.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Fajita Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Green bell pepper (cut into strips)
1 pc Large white onion (cut into strips)
instructions: In a bowl, combine the chicken, lime juice, cumin, red pepper, salt and ground pepper. Mix well.
Heat oil in pan. Then fry the chicken for 3-5 minutes.
After frying, cut the chicken into strips. Then fry again in the same pan for about 2 minutes.
Then add the onion and green bell pepper. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Transfer in a plate. Serve with tortillas. Enjoy!

title: Best Vegetable Omelette Recipe
instructions: In a cooking pan, heat 1 tbsp butter.
Put-in mushroom with green and red bell pepper.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix well and cook for about 2-3 minutes. Then transfer in a bowl. Set aside.
Beat the eggs and pour-in the bowl with cooked vegetables. Mix well. Set aside.
In another pan, heat the remaining butter and gently pour the mixed ingredients until you formed a circle. Then cook for 5 minutes. Do the same on the other side.
Transfer on a plate. Serve with bread. Enjoy!

title: Best Crispy Crablets Recipe
instructions: Place the crablets in a bowl then pour-in gin or sherry. Mix gently.
Sprinkle salt and ground black pepper then mix well.
Heat a frying pan or cooking pot and pour-in cooking oil.
Dredge the crablets in cornstarch then deep fry until the texture becomes crispy.
Remove from the pan and place in a plate lined with paper towel.
Once excess oil drips-off completely, arrange in a serving plate and serve with spicy vinegar dip.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Adobong Dilaw Recipe
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a cooking pot.
Saute garlic, onion and turmeric. Cook for about 1-2 minutes.
Then add the pork. Season with salt and pepper. Mix well and continue cooking for 5 minutes.
Then add the bay leaf and cook for another 5 minutes while covered over low heat.
After 5 minutes, pour-in water and vinegar and cook for another 20 minutes over medium heat. Wait until the meat gets tender.
Ready to serve. Enjoy!

title: Best Kilawing Puso ng Saging Recipe
ingredients: 2 pcs Long green chilies (cut into small pieces)
instructions: Heat oil in a cooking pot.
Saute garlic and onion until cook.
Add the pork and season with fish sauce.
Then pour-in water and stir carefully. Cover and boil for 10 minutes.
After 10 minutes, put the banana blossoms. Cover and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Add the vinegar and chilies then simmer for about 10 minutes over low heat.
Transfer into a serving plate.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Crab with Misua Recipe
instructions: Heat the cooking oil in a cooking pot.
Saute the garlic and ginger.
Add the onion. Cook until the onion becomes soft.
Add-in the crabs. Pour-in the fish sauce and add water . Let it boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle some ground black pepper. Let the water reboil. Cook for 1 minute.
Put-in the misua noodles. Stir and cook for 1 minute.
Add the spring onions. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes more.
Transfer to a serving bowl.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Ginisang Labanos Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Medium carrot (sliced into thick strips)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan.
Saute garlic and onion until cook. Then add tomato and cook until it melts.
Add the pork, then pour-in water and boil for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes. Add fish sauce and pepper. Simmer for another 5 minutes.
Then add the radish and carrot. Cover and boil for about 10 minutes over low heat. Stir occasionally.
Serve while hot. Enjoy!

title: Best Pork Parmesan Recipe
ingredients: 6 pcs Boneless porkloin (cut into 1/2 inch wide)
instructions: In a bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper and paprika. Mix well. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan.  Wait until it gets hot.
Beat the egg in a separate bowl then dip each pork into it. Then dredge in the breadcrumbs mixture.
Then carefully put in the pan and fry until golden brown. Do the same on the other side of the pork.
After frying, remove the pork from the pan and place in a plate.
Put some tomato sauce and cheese on top.
Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Egg Drop Soup Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 cup Spring onion (cut into small pieces)
instructions: Dilute the cornstarch in 1/4 cup water. Stir and mix well. Set aside.
In a casserole, pour-in the chicken stock then season with salt and pepper
Heat the casserole and boil for 5 minutes.
Then add the soy sauce.
Pour-in the beaten egg. Stir.
Add-in the cornstarch diluted in water. Continue to stir until the texture of the soup reaches your desired texture.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle green onions on top.
Serve, share and enjoy!

title: Best Tuna Frittata Recipe
instructions: Grease the pie molder with cooking oil and rubbing it on the surface. Set aside.
In a bowl, combine egg and tuna. Then season with salt and pepper. Mix well.
Get the pie molder and pour the mixture in it.
Pre-heat the oven over 370 degrees F.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.`
Sprinkle the cheese on top. Set the oven to broil and then continue broiling for 3 minutes.
Serve with toasted bread. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Pork Empanada Recipe
instructions: Prepare the pastry by combining flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl. Mix well.
Then add the shortening and water. Mix well for 10 minutes until it gets smooth. Cover and set aside.
Cook the filling by heating oil in a pan.
Saute garlic and onion for 5 minutes. Then add the ground pork, season with salt and pepper. Stir continuously until it boils or until the pork turns brown.
Then pour-in water and boil for another 10 minutes over low heat.
After 10 minutes, add the potatoes and carrots. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Once the potatoes soften, add the bell pepper and sugar. Cook for another 2-3 minutes. Set aside.
Get the pastry and transfer into a flat surface. Mold a large sphere out of it. Separate in half, and then create a disk shaped figure on each piece of pastry.

Scoop 2 tablespoon of pork filling in the center of the circular pastry. Secure it by folding both sides of the pastry towards each other. Use your thumb and index finger to pinch the sides for it to cling to each other. Secure it even more by pressing the tip of a fork on the sides of the empanada. Set aside.
Heat oil in pan. Fry the empanada until brown over low heat.
Then remove from the pan. Let it cool down.
Serve while hot. Enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Barbecue Wrap Recipe
instructions: Slice the chicken and season with barbecue sauce, paprika, salt, black pepper and cayenne pepper. Mix well and cover for 20 minutes. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Place the chicken on it and spread with barbecue sauce, then fry until light brown. Set aside.

Prepare the coleslaw dressing by combining the ingredients in a bowl: carrots, cabbage, onion, mayonnaise, sour cream, mustard, apple cider vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Mix until the ingredients are well-blended. Set aside.
Get the fried chicken and slice into cubes.
Then, fill the tortilla wrap with lettuce, coleslaw and the sliced chicken.

Secure the contents by wrapping the tortilla all over it. Do this by folding a quarter of both sides (left and right) inwards. Roll the flour tortilla from bottom to top until the contents are secured.
Serve, share and enjoy!

title: Superior Chicken Cordon Bleu Recipe
instructions: Place a plastic wrap over a flat surface. Arrange a piece of chicken over the wrap, and then cover the chicken with it. Pound the chicken using a meat tenderizer tool until it flattens.
Sprinkle salt all over the chicken breast.
Prepare the filling by putting a slice of cheese and ham over the chicken. Roll the chicken to cover the filling and then seal it by inserting toothpicks into the rolled chicken.
Heat oil in a cooking pot.
Dip the chicken in beaten egg and then roll over the bread crumbs. Do this step twice to make the coating thicker.

Deep fry for 12 minutes in medium heat. Note. if you need to turn the chicken over to fry the opposite side, you can do so and cook it for 8 minutes. If you will deep while the chicken is fully submerged, 12 minutes should be enough, but feel free to cook no longer than 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot. Let it cool down. Slice into serving pieces.
Prepare the sauce by melting butter in a sauce pan. Add onion. Cook until soft.
Pour heavy whipping cream. Let boil. Add Dijon mustard. Stir and continue to cook in medium heat until it reduces to half. Add salt to taste.
Pour sauce over the chicken. Serve.
Share and enjoy!

title: Best Ube Kalamay Recipe
instructions: In a pan, combine coconut milk, glutinous powder, latik, sugar, water and ube extract. Mix well using a wire whisk. Set aside.
Put on the stove and turn on the heat. Cook the ube mixture until it boils, continue to cook until the mixture becomes very thick.Note: Cook over low heat to avoid sticking on the pan.
Put the cooked ube kalamay in the mold. Spread it around the mold. Brush remaining coconut oil over the ube kalamay. Flatten top using a spoon. Top with margarine and latik.
Let the kalamay cool down for 1 hour. Serve and enjoy!

title: Superb Chicken Alfredo Cuisine
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package instructions. Drain water and set aside.
Season chicken with paprika, salt and pepper. Let it stay for 10 minutes.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a pan. Add olive oil.
Pan-fry chicken for 3 minutes per side. Remove chicken from the pan. Slice into serving pieces. Set aside.
In another pan, cook butter and garlic over medium heat until garlic turns brown.
Then add the cream, add salt, pepper and nutmeg. Let it boil for another 5 minutes.
When boiling, add-in the noodles and cook for about 5 minutes.
Transfer into serving plate. Put the chicken on top of the noodles, parsley and cheese.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Corned Beef Omelette Recipe
instructions: Prepare the corned beef by sautéing. Heat oil in a pan and then saute tomato and onion.
Add corned beef. Continue to saute for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the pan and let it cool down.
Crack the eggs and place in a large mixing bowl. Add the salt and pepper.. Beat until all the ingredients are well incorporated.
Add sautéed Corned beef. Stir to mix the ingredients. Note: Make sure that the corned beef has cooled down before you execute this step.
Heat a frying pan. Add 1 tablespoon cooking oil. Scoop around ½ to ¾ cups of the corned beef and egg mixture and pour in the pan. Cook for 3 minutes on medium heat.
Use a spatula to flip the omelet and cook the other side for 2 to 3 minutes.
Transfer to a serving plate. Serve and enjoy!

title: Superior Buko Pandan Salad
instructions: Combine water and powdered gelatin then stir using a spoon.
Add Buko Pandan flavoring then stir until everything is evenly distributed.
Heat a saucepan and pour-in the mixture. Bring to a boil while continuously stirring.

Turn off the heat and transfer the mixture to a mold. Allow the temperature to cool. The texture of the mixture should be firm once cooled. You may also place this inside the refrigerator for faster results (allow the temperature to go down before putting-in the refrigerator).
Combine condensed milk, nestle cream, sago pearls, and young coconut then mix well. Allow the texture to thicken by chilling in the refrigerator or freezer for a few hours.
Slice the firm gelatin into 1 inch cubes then combine with the condensed milk-cream-young coconut-sago mixture.
Transfer to individual serving platters. Serve for dessert. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Yema Cooking Instructions
instructions: Combine egg yolks and condensed milk. Mix well.
Add chopped peanuts. Whisk until well blended.
Melt butter in a cooking pot or pan. Pour the egg yolk mixture into the pan.
Continue to cook until the consistency becomes very thick to the point that it can easily form a shape when molded.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Let it cool down.

Cut the cellophane into 3x3 inch pieces. Scoop 1 tablespoons of mixture and place at the middle of the cellophane. Wrap the yema while molding to form a pyramid shape piece (note: watch the video for details). Continue to wrap the yema until all the mixture are consumed.
Serve . Share and enjoy.

title: Best Pork Stir Fry Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Red bell pepper (cut into strips)
instructions: Arrange pork in a bowl. Add salt, sugar, pepper, garlic and ginger. Mix well.
Add cornstarch and soy sauce. Continue to mix until all ingredients are well blended.
Heat oil in a pan. Once the oil gets hot, cook chicharo, bell peppe and onion for 5 minutes. Then transfer in a plate. Set aside.
In the same pan, add more cooking oil and stir-fry the pork for 10 minutes or until crispy brown.
Then, transfer to a serving plate. Serve and enjoy!

title: Best Dinengdeng Recipe
instructions: In a casserole, pour-in water with bagoong, ginger, onion, and tomatoes. Let it boil.
Then add the stringbeans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the bittergourd and okra. Let it boil for another 5 minutes.
Then put the malunggay leaves with squash flowers and boil for 3 minutes.
Transfer in a serving bowl. Eat with grilled fish. Enjoy!

title: Superior Gyoza Menu
instructions: Mash the cabbage. Add salt. Continue to mash until salt is well distributed. Let it stay for 10 minutes.
Combine ground pork, shrimp, and ginger in bowl. Mix well.
Add cabbage, ground pepper, cooking wine, Sesame oil, and liquid seasoning. Continue to mix until all ingredients are well blended.

Scoop 1 ½ teaspoon of pork mixture and place it in the middle of the Gyoza wrapper. Secure the filling by symmetrically folding the wrapper and pressing the edges. You may also press using the tip of a fork.
Arrange the pork dumplings on a steamer lined with cabbage leaves. Cover and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve with dipping sauce. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Orange Chicken Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb Chicken breast (cut into bite size)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken breast with egg white and cornstarch, then mix well. Cover and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
For the sauce, get a frying pan and put-in together all the ingredients: orange juice, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, salt and pepper, garlic, ginger and water.
Turn on the heat and cook for 5 minutes.
Then, gradually pour-in the melted cornstarch into the pan and simmer for another 5 minutes. Wait until the sauce gets thick. Set aside.
In another frying pan, fry the seasoned chicken until golden brown.
Then, pour-in the cooked sauce into the pan with chicken and simmer for about 2-3 minutes.
Serve while hot! Enjoy.

title: Best Maja Blanca Recipe
instructions: Pour-in coconut milk in a pan. Turn on the heat then stir carefully until it boils.
When boiling, add the sugar, sweetened milk and corn. Continue stirring and let it boil for 10 minutes.
Then, add the melted cornstarch and gradually pour in the pan. Mix well until it gets thick.
Prepare the tray and pour-in carefully the cooked mixture on it.
Sprinkle with Latik on top and let it cool for 1 hour. Then, refrigerate for another 30 minutes.
Serve, eat and enjoy!

title: Best Chicken Lollipop Recipe
instructions: Divide the chicken wing into 3 parts by slicing through the joints. Set aside the wingtip for other possible uses.
Shape the wing to look like a lollipop. You should have two parts of the chicken wing by now: the one with a single bone and the one with two bones. Start by selecting the part with one bone.
Separate the meat from the bone by sliding a sharp knife around the tip of the bone where meat is still connected (do not cut through the bone).
Place the wing vertically on top of a flat surface while holding the part where the knife passed.
Gently push downward while gripping the bone with your thumb and index finger until the meat slides down.
Arrange the meat by inverting the inner part until a lollipop shape is formed.
Season the chicken lollipops with salt and pepper and let it stand for at least 15 minutes.
Crack the eggs and transfer to a bowl then whisk. Then, gradually add-in the all-purpose flour while whisking until a batter is formed.
Dip the chicken lollipop on the batter then to the breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a cooking pot then deep-fry the chicken lollipop under medium heat until the color of the outer part turns medium brown (about 10 to 12 minutes).
Remove the fried chicken lollipop from the cooking pot and transfer to a dish with paper towel. Let it stand until excess oil is absorbed by the paper towel.
Serve with your favorite dip. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Tartar Sauce Recipe
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together mayonnaise, and sweet pickle relish, Stir in lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Best Beef Salisbury Steak Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, season the ground beef with pepper, garlic powder, salt and breadcrumbs.
Then pour-in the Worcestershire sauce. Mix well.
Scoop around 4 tablespoons of mixture and roll into a ball. Flatten and place in a clean plate. Set aside.
Heat butter in frying pan. Then fry the beef over low heat until brown. Remove from the pan, set aside.
In the same pan, cook mushroom and stir for 5 minutes.
Then put the flour and cook for another 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, gradually pour the beef stock and water. Stir continuously until it boils.
Then add the cooked beef and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve while hot. Enjoy!

title: Best Crispy Spinach Recipe
instructions: Prepare the spinach leaves. Clean and wash with water then let it dry.
In a bowl, combine flour, egg, salt, chili powder, and olive oil. Mix well and set aside.
Then heat cooking oil in a pan.
Dip the washed spinach leaves in the flour mixture then fry in the pan. Cook until light brown.
Transfer into a serving plate. Share and enjoy!

title: Best Hardenera Recipe
instructions: Remove the shell of the boiled eggs and cut into halves. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine ground pork, green peas, bread crumbs, pickle relish, fresh eggs, raisins, bell pepper, salt and ground pepper. Mix well and set aside.
Prepare the Llanera and scoop the pork mixture in to the llanera until it occupies at least 3/4 of the total volume.
Arrange the sliced eggs and ensure that the eggs are well distributed on the llanera.
Then, cover the whole llanera with aluminum foil. Set aside.
Pour at least 6 cups of water in the steamer. Arrange the containers in the steamer and steam for 40 minutes.
After 40 minutes, remove the steamed mixture from the llanera and transfer to a serving plate.
Serve while hot! Eat and enjoy.

title: Best Banana Pudding Recipe
instructions: Put the brown sugar in the molder and 1 tbsp of water, then combine it with a medium flame to caramelize the water and sugar, and apply the caramel to all parts of the molder.
Put in a bowl with shredded bread, Eggs, Powdered milk, Evaporated Milk, Vanilla, Cinnamon Powder and Banana and mix it and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Put the water in the steamer and boil it, Take the mold with Caramel and add the Mixed Banana Pudding and put it in the steamer cover and cook for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes remove the Pudding to Steamer and prune it until the dough is clean enough that the banana pudding is cooked.
Now cut it and serve it. Enjoy!

title: Best Pico De Gallo Recipe
ingredients: 1 pc Green bell pepper (small size, diced)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine tomato, onion, Green Bell Pepper and Kinchay. Season salt and Lemon squeeze. Stir until evenly distributed.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Serve with Nacho. Enjoy!

title: The Best Pulled Pork Recipe
instructions: Put together in a bowl the ingredients. Sugar, Chile powder, Paprika, Garlic powder, Salt and Cayenne Pepper and mix it.
Put the pork in a bowl, spread the mixed ingredients in the pork and add the onion
Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F.
Cook it for 6 hours. Sometimes it will rotate, add 1 cup of  water.
Shred the meat with two forks and serve with bread.
Enjoy eating!

title: Best Chicken Salad Recipe
instructions: In a large bowl, put-in chicken breast and mix with yogurt, mayonnaise.
Then season with salt and pepper. Mix until the ingredients are well-blended with the chicken.
Serve with lettuce. Share and enjoy!

title: Superb Kutsinta Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, cornstarch and salt. Mix well.
Then add the sugar and mix gently.
Pour-in water gradually  and continue to mix until all ingredients are completely distributed.
Place the mixture into individual molds and steam for 20 minutes to an hour.
Serve with grated or shredder coconut on top. Share and Enjoy!

title: Best Chicksilog Recipe
instructions: In a bowl, season chicken with salt, pepper and calamansi extract. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes Set aside.
Heat oil in a frying pan. Fry 4 eggs then remove from the pan. Set aside.
In a bowl, beat an egg using a fork.
Then pour the flour in flat plate.
Get the chicken then dip in the beaten egg and dredge in the flour.
In the same pan (you used in cooking the egg), gently fry the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side or until crispy brown over low medium heat.
